source.text: וַיִּקְח֞וּ כָּל־עַ֤ם יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת־עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וְה֕וּא בֶּן־שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיַּמְלִ֣יכוּ אֹת֔וֹ תַּ֖חַת אָבִ֥יו אֲמַצְיָֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And took all [the] people of Judah Uzziah, and he [was] a son of sixteen year[s], and they made king him in place of his father Amaziah.

en.L: And all the people of Judah took Uzziah, and he [was] sixteen years old, and they made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
en.B: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, then sixteen years old, and made him king to succeed his father Amaziah.
en.R: Then all the people of Judah chose Uzziah, Amaziah's son, and made him king in his father's place. Uzziah was sixteen years old.

es.L: Y todo el pueblo de Judá tomó a Uzías, que [tenía] dieciséis años, y lo hicieron rey en lugar de su padre Amasías.
es.B: Entonces todo el pueblo de Judá tomó a Uzías, que tenía dieciséis años, y lo hicieron rey en lugar de su padre Amasías.
es.R: Entonces todo el pueblo de Judá escogió a Uzías, hijo de Amasías, y lo hizo rey en lugar de su padre. Uzías tenía dieciséis años.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple de Juda prit Ozias, et il [avait] seize ans, et ils le firent roi à la place de son père Amatsia.
fr.B: Alors tout le peuple de Juda prit Ozias, qui avait seize ans, et le fit roi pour succéder à son père Amatsia.
fr.R: Alors tout le peuple de Juda a choisi Ozias, le fils d’Amatsia, et l’a fait roi à la place de son père. Ozias avait seize ans.

sw.L: Na watu wote wa Yuda wakamchukua Uzia, naye [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka kumi na sita, wakamtawaza kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake Amazia.
sw.B: Kisha watu wote wa Yuda walimchukua Uzia, aliyekuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na sita wakati huo, wakamtawaza kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake Amazia.
sw.R: Kisha watu wote wa Yuda walimchagua Uzia, mwana wa Amazia, wakamtawaza kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake. Uzia alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na sita.

vi.L: Toàn dân Giu-đa lấy Ô-xia, lúc ấy [được] mười sáu tuổi, và lập người làm vua thay cho A-ma-xia cha người.
vi.B: Bấy giờ toàn dân Giu-đa đưa Ô-xia, khi ấy được mười sáu tuổi, lên làm vua kế vị A-ma-xia cha mình.
vi.R: Bấy giờ toàn dân Giu-đa chọn Ô-xia, con trai A-ma-xia, và lập người làm vua thay cha. Lúc ấy Ô-xia được mười sáu tuổi.

ko.L: 그리고 유다의 온 백성이 웃시야를 데려왔다. 그는 16세[였다]. 그리고 그들이 그의 아버지 아마샤를 대신하여 그를 왕으로 삼았다.
ko.B: 그러자 유다의 온 백성이 그때 16세였던 웃시야를 데려다가 그의 아버지 아마샤의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 그러자 유다의 온 백성이 아마샤의 아들 웃시야를 골라 그의 아버지의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다. 웃시야는 16세였다.

pt.L: E todo o povo de Judá tomou Uzias, e ele [tinha] dezesseis anos, e o fizeram rei em lugar do seu pai Amazias.
pt.B: Então todo o povo de Judá tomou Uzias, que tinha dezesseis anos, e o fez rei no lugar do seu pai Amazias.
pt.R: Então todo o povo de Judá escolheu Uzias, filho de Amazias, e o fez rei no lugar do pai. Uzias tinha dezesseis anos.

decisions.choice: Uzziah: the king Kings mostly calls Azariah
decisions.reason: This verse repeats 2 Kings 14:21 word for word, except that Kings names the king Azariah. Kings uses both names (Azariah in 2 Kings 15:1-8; Uzziah in 15:13, 30-34); Chronicles and the prophets use Uzziah (Isaiah 1:1; 6:1; Hosea 1:1; Amos 1:1). The names are close in meaning, "Yahweh has helped" and "Yahweh is my strength", and both name the same king. Each verse keeps the name it uses; in this chapter Azariah is also the name of the priest who stands against the king (verses 17 and 20).

decisions.choice: all the people of Judah: the nation acting together
decisions.reason: Amaziah had been killed by plotters at Lachish (25:27-28). The people, not the plotters, chose the next king, and they chose Amaziah's son, so David's line went on.

decisions.choice: a son of sixteen years: sixteen years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years.

decisions.choice: took (Balanced); chose (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 14:21 is kept at each level, with the name Uzziah. Readable says "chose" for "took", names him as Amaziah's son and gives his age in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: the wording of Spanish 2 Kings 14:21; "Uzías"
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its Spanish of 2 Kings 14:21, with the name Uzías where Chronicles has it, as the terms note keeps each verse's form of the king's name (m1).

decisions.choice: "Ozias", with the wording of French 2 Kings 14:21
decisions.reason: Chronicles calls this king Uzziah where Kings mostly says Azariah (m1); French keeps each verse's form, "Ozias" being the usual French name of the king of Isaiah 6:1.

decisions.choice: Uzia
decisions.reason: Chronicles names the king Uzziah where 2 Kings 14:21 and 15:1-7 mostly say Azariah; the Swahili keeps each book's form (Uzia here) and the wording of Kings at each level.

decisions.choice: "Ô-xia"
decisions.reason: Chronicles calls this king Uzziah, where 2 Kings mostly says Azariah (m1); the terms note gives both forms and each verse keeps its own.

decisions.choice: "웃시야", the name Chronicles uses, in the wording of 2 Kings 14:21, with the age in figures
decisions.reason: Each verse keeps its own form of the king's name (terms note; m1).

decisions.choice: Uzias (Azarias in 2 Kings 14:21 and 15:1-7); the wording of 2 Kings 14:21
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the verse repeats 2 Kings 14:21 (m1), and so does the Portuguese at each level, with the one name changed. Chronicles calls the king Uzziah, and the English follows it, so Portuguese writes "Uzias", the form 2 Kings 15:13 and 15:32-34 use in Portuguese for the same king; 2 Kings 14:21-15:7 in Portuguese calls him "Azarias", as Kings does there. The priest of verse 17 keeps the name "Azarias".

source.text: ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־אֵיל֔וֹת וַיְשִׁיבֶ֖הָ לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֥י שְׁכַֽב־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah, after lay down the king with his fathers.

en.L: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah, after the king lay down with his fathers.
en.B: It was he who rebuilt Eloth and won it back for Judah, after King Amaziah had rested with his ancestors.
en.R: After his father Amaziah died, Uzziah rebuilt the town of Eloth and made it part of Judah again.

es.L: Él edificó Elot y la restituyó a Judá, después que el rey durmió con sus padres.
es.B: Fue él quien reconstruyó Elot y la recuperó para Judá, después de que el rey Amasías descansó con sus antepasados.
es.R: Después de que murió su padre Amasías, Uzías reconstruyó la ciudad de Elot y la hizo otra vez parte de Judá.

fr.L: C’est lui qui bâtit Éloth et la rendit à Juda, après que le roi se fut couché avec ses pères.
fr.B: C’est lui qui rebâtit Éloth et la rendit à Juda, après que le roi Amatsia eut reposé avec ses ancêtres.
fr.R: Après la mort de son père Amatsia, Ozias a reconstruit la ville d’Éloth et l’a rendue à Juda.

sw.L: Yeye ndiye aliyeijenga Elothi na kuirudisha kwa Yuda, baada ya mfalme kulala pamoja na baba zake.
sw.B: Yeye ndiye aliyeijenga upya Elothi na kuirudisha kwa Yuda, baada ya mfalme Amazia kupumzika pamoja na babu zake.
sw.R: Baada ya baba yake Amazia kufa, Uzia aliujenga upya mji wa Elothi na kuufanya tena kuwa sehemu ya Yuda.

vi.L: Người xây Ê-lốt và khôi phục nó cho Giu-đa, sau khi vua [cha] nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình.
vi.B: Chính Ô-xia đã xây lại Ê-lốt và giành lại thành ấy cho Giu-đa, sau khi vua A-ma-xia đã an giấc cùng tổ tiên.
vi.R: Sau khi A-ma-xia cha mình qua đời, Ô-xia xây lại thị trấn Ê-lốt và sáp nhập nó vào Giu-đa một lần nữa.

ko.L: 그가 엘롯을 건축하여 그것을 유다에 되돌렸다. 왕이 그의 조상들과 함께 누운 뒤였다.
ko.B: 엘롯을 다시 건축하여 유다에 되돌려 놓은 사람이 바로 그였다. 그것은 아마샤 왕이 조상들과 함께 잠든 뒤의 일이었다.
ko.R: 그의 아버지 아마샤가 죽은 뒤에, 웃시야는 엘롯 성읍을 다시 짓고 그곳을 다시 유다 땅으로 만들었다.

pt.L: Ele edificou Elote e a restituiu a Judá, depois que o rei descansou com os seus pais.
pt.B: Foi ele que reconstruiu Elote e a recuperou para Judá, depois que o rei Amazias descansou com os seus antepassados.
pt.R: Depois que o seu pai Amazias morreu, Uzias reconstruiu a cidade de Elote e fez com que ela voltasse a ser de Judá.

decisions.choice: Eloth: the town Kings calls Elath
decisions.reason: This verse repeats 2 Kings 14:22. The only difference is the spelling of the town's name: Kings has Elath, Chronicles Eloth, as in 8:17. It was Judah's port at the head of the Gulf of Aqaba, near Ezion-geber (1 Kings 9:26), lost when Edom broke away (21:8-10).

decisions.choice: he: Uzziah; the king: Amaziah
decisions.reason: The stressed pronoun "he" points to Uzziah. "The king" who lay down with his fathers is Amaziah: Uzziah won the town back after his father's death, finishing what Amaziah's victory over Edom had begun (25:11-12).

decisions.choice: built: rebuilt, fortified
decisions.reason: The town already existed; "build" here means to rebuild and strengthen it.

decisions.choice: It was he (Balanced); Amaziah; Uzziah
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 14:22, Balanced shows the stress on "he" and names King Amaziah; Readable names both kings so the reader does not confuse them, and says "died" for the death formula.

decisions.choice: "Elot"
decisions.reason: The town as the Hebrew of Chronicles spells it, where Spanish 2 Kings 14:22 has Elat (m1).

decisions.choice: "Éloth"
decisions.reason: The verse's own spelling of the town French 2 Kings 14:22 calls "Élath"; the English also keeps the two forms.

decisions.choice: "vua [cha]"
decisions.reason: "The king" here is Amaziah (m2); Literal supplies "cha" in brackets so the reader does not take him for Uzziah.

decisions.choice: "엘롯", as Chronicles spells the town
decisions.reason: The spelling of each book is kept, as the English does (m1); 엘롯 is also the form used at 1 Kings 9:26.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 14:22, with "Elote" for "Elate"
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 2 Kings 14:22 (m1), and the Portuguese keeps that verse at each level. Only the name differs, as it differs in the Hebrew: Chronicles' spelling is "Elote", the form 8:17 uses in Portuguese, where Kings has "Elate".

source.text: בֶּן־שֵׁ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֨יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְכָלְיָ֖ה מִן־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of six-teen year[s] [was] Uzziah when he became king, and fifty and two year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and [the] name of his mother [was] Jecoliah from Jerusalem.

en.L: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and fifty-two years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother [was] Jecoliah from Jerusalem.
en.B: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
en.R: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for fifty-two years. His mother was Jecoliah from Jerusalem.

es.L: Hijo de dieciséis años [era] Uzías cuando comenzó a reinar, y cincuenta y dos años reinó en Jerusalén; y el nombre de su madre [era] Jecolías, de Jerusalén.
es.B: Uzías tenía dieciséis años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó cincuenta y dos años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Jecolías y era de Jerusalén.
es.R: Uzías tenía dieciséis años cuando llegó a ser rey, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante cincuenta y dos años. Su madre se llamaba Jecolías y era de Jerusalén.

fr.L: Ozias [avait] seize ans quand il devint roi, et il régna cinquante-deux ans à Jérusalem ; et le nom de sa mère [était] Yekolia, de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Ozias avait seize ans quand il devint roi, et il régna cinquante-deux ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Yekolia ; elle était de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Ozias avait seize ans quand il est devenu roi. Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant cinquante-deux ans. Sa mère s’appelait Yekolia ; elle était de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Uzia [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka kumi na sita alipoanza kutawala, na miaka hamsini na miwili alitawala huko Yerusalemu; na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Yekolia wa Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Uzia alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na sita alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka hamsini na miwili huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Yekolia; alikuwa wa Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Uzia alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na sita alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka hamsini na miwili. Mama yake aliitwa Yekolia wa Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Ô-xia [được] mười sáu tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì năm mươi hai năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ vua [là] Giê-cô-lia, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Ô-xia được mười sáu tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì năm mươi hai năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-cô-lia, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Ô-xia được mười sáu tuổi khi lên làm vua. Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem năm mươi hai năm. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-cô-lia, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 웃시야가 왕이 되었을 때 16세였고, 예루살렘에서 52년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 예루살렘 출신 여골리야였다.
ko.B: 웃시야는 16세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 52년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 여골리야였고, 예루살렘 출신이었다.
ko.R: 웃시야는 16세에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 52년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 예루살렘 출신 여골리야였다.

pt.L: Uzias tinha dezesseis anos quando começou a reinar, e cinquenta e dois anos reinou em Jerusalém; e o nome da sua mãe [era] Jecolias, de Jerusalém.
pt.B: Uzias tinha dezesseis anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou cinquenta e dois anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Jecolias; ela era de Jerusalém.
pt.R: Uzias tinha dezesseis anos quando se tornou rei. Governou em Jerusalém durante cinquenta e dois anos. A mãe dele era Jecolias, de Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 15:2, with the name Uzziah
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 2 Kings 15:2, but names the king, Uzziah, where Kings says "he". Chronicles leaves out the date by the reign of Jeroboam of Israel (2 Kings 15:1), as it usually leaves out the kings of the north.

decisions.choice: fifty-two years: a reign that may include years shared with others
decisions.reason: This is one of the longest reigns of any king of Judah. For part of it his son Jotham ruled for him (verse 21), and the count may include years when he ruled beside his father.

decisions.choice: Jecoliah: the name as the scribes marked it to be read
decisions.reason: The written text and the form the scribes marked to be read aloud spell the queen mother's name slightly differently. Both name the same woman, called Jecoliah in 2 Kings 15:2.

decisions.choice: sixteen years old
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 15:2 is kept at each level, with the king's name added as the Hebrew has it.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 15:2 with the name "Ô-xia"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is that of 2 Kings 15:2 with the name Uzziah (m1).

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 15:2, with "Uzias" for "Ele"; Jecolias
decisions.reason: The accession formula repeats 2 Kings 15:2 in Portuguese level by level, with the king's name where Kings says "he" (m1); the queen mother keeps the form Kings gives her in Portuguese, "Jecolias" (m3).

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh, according to all that had done Amaziah his father.

en.L: And he did the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, according to all that Amaziah his father had done.
en.B: He did what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as his father Amaziah had done.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right, just as his father Amaziah had done.

es.L: E hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, conforme a todo lo que había hecho Amasías su padre.
es.B: Hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como lo había hecho su padre Amasías.
es.R: Hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, tal como lo había hecho su padre Amasías.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon tout ce qu’avait fait Amatsia son père.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, tout comme son père Amatsia.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon, comme son père Amatsia l’avait fait.

sw.L: Naye akafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na yote aliyoyafanya Amazia baba yake.
sw.B: Alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama baba yake Amazia alivyofanya.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema, kama baba yake Amazia alivyofanya.

vi.L: Vua làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo mọi điều A-ma-xia cha vua đã làm.
vi.B: Vua làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đúng như A-ma-xia cha vua đã làm.
vi.R: Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải, đúng như A-ma-xia cha vua đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 아버지 아마샤가 한 모든 일대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 했다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지 아마샤가 한 것처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 아버지 아마샤처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다.

pt.L: E fez o reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, conforme tudo o que Amazias, seu pai, tinha feito.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, assim como o seu pai Amazias tinha feito.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava certo, assim como o seu pai Amazias tinha feito.

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 15:3, without the high places
decisions.reason: The verdict is word for word that of 2 Kings 15:3. Kings goes on to say that the high places were not removed (15:4); Chronicles leaves that out and instead shows how Uzziah's faithfulness lasted only for a time (verses 5 and 16).

decisions.choice: according to all that Amaziah his father had done: a likeness that cuts both ways
decisions.reason: Amaziah too began well and then turned away (25:2, 14-16). The comparison prepares for Uzziah's own fall in verse 16.

decisions.choice: did the right in [the] eyes of / did what was right in the sight of / did what the LORD said was right
decisions.reason: The verdict formula has one wording at each level throughout these books.

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 15:3
decisions.reason: The verdict is word for word that of 2 Kings 15:3 (m1), and so is the Portuguese at each level.

source.text: וַיְהִי֙ לִדְרֹ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בִּימֵ֣י זְכַרְיָ֔הוּ הַמֵּבִ֖ין בִּרְאֹ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבִימֵי֙ דָּרְשׁ֣וֹ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה הִצְלִיח֖וֹ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he was to seek God in [the] days of Zechariah, the [one] giving understanding in the seeing of God; and in [the] days of his seeking Yahweh, made him prosper God.

en.L: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who instructed [him] in the fear of God; and in the days when he sought {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, God made him prosper.
en.B: He set himself to seek God during the lifetime of Zechariah, who taught him the fear of God. As long as he sought {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, God gave him success.
en.R: Uzziah tried to follow God as long as Zechariah was alive. Zechariah taught him to respect and obey God. As long as Uzziah looked to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, God made him successful.

es.L: Y buscó a Dios en los días de Zacarías, que [lo] instruía en el temor de Dios; y en los días en que buscó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios lo prosperó.
es.B: Se dedicó a buscar a Dios mientras vivió Zacarías, que le enseñó el temor de Dios. Mientras buscó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios le dio prosperidad.
es.R: Uzías procuró seguir a Dios mientras Zacarías estuvo vivo. Zacarías le enseñó a respetar y obedecer a Dios. Mientras Uzías buscó la ayuda {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios le dio éxito.

fr.L: Et il chercha Dieu aux jours de Zacharie, qui [l’]instruisait dans la crainte de Dieu ; et aux jours où il chercha {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu le fit réussir.
fr.B: Il s’appliqua à chercher Dieu du vivant de Zacharie, qui lui enseignait la crainte de Dieu. Aussi longtemps qu’il chercha {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu le fit réussir.
fr.R: Ozias a essayé de suivre Dieu tant que Zacharie était en vie. Zacharie lui apprenait à respecter Dieu et à lui obéir. Tant qu’Ozias a compté sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu l’a fait réussir.

sw.L: Naye akamtafuta Mungu katika siku za Zekaria, aliyemfundisha katika kumcha Mungu; na katika siku alizomtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu akamfanikisha.
sw.B: Alikaza nia kumtafuta Mungu wakati wa maisha ya Zekaria, aliyemfundisha kumcha Mungu. Muda wote alipomtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu alimpa mafanikio.
sw.R: Uzia alijitahidi kumfuata Mungu wakati wote Zekaria alipokuwa hai. Zekaria alimfundisha kumheshimu na kumtii Mungu. Muda wote Uzia alipomtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa msaada, Mungu alimfanikisha.

vi.L: Vua tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời trong những ngày của Xa-cha-ri, người dạy [vua] về sự kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời; và trong những ngày vua tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời cho vua được thịnh vượng.
vi.B: Vua chuyên tâm tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời suốt đời Xa-cha-ri, người đã dạy vua kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời. Bao lâu vua còn tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời còn cho vua được thành công.
vi.R: Ô-xia cố gắng theo Đức Chúa Trời bao lâu Xa-cha-ri còn sống. Xa-cha-ri đã dạy vua tôn kính và vâng lời Đức Chúa Trời. Bao lâu Ô-xia còn trông cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời còn cho vua thành công.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 하나님을 경외하도록 가르친 스가랴의 날들에 하나님을 찾았다. 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾은 날들에는 하나님께서 그를 형통하게 하셨다.
ko.B: 그는 하나님을 경외하도록 그를 가르친 스가랴가 살아 있는 동안 하나님을 찾기에 힘썼다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾는 동안에는 하나님께서 그를 형통하게 하셨다.
ko.R: 웃시야는 스가랴가 살아 있는 동안 하나님을 따르려고 애썼다. 스가랴는 그에게 하나님을 두려워하며 그분께 순종하라고 가르쳤다. 웃시야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 의지하는 동안에는 하나님께서 그를 잘되게 하셨다.

pt.L: E ele buscou a Deus nos dias de Zacarias, que o instruía no temor de Deus; e nos dias em que buscou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, Deus o fez prosperar.
pt.B: Ele se dedicou a buscar a Deus durante a vida de Zacarias, que o instruía no temor de Deus. Enquanto buscou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, Deus lhe deu sucesso.
pt.R: Uzias procurou seguir a Deus enquanto Zacarias estava vivo. Zacarias o ensinava a respeitar e obedecer a Deus. Enquanto Uzias buscou a ajuda {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, Deus o fez prosperar.

decisions.choice: in the fear of God
alternatives: who had understanding in the visions of God
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text as printed reads "in the seeing of God", which could mean that Zechariah understood visions from God. Many Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient Greek and Syriac translations read "in the fear of God"; the two words look very much alike in Hebrew. "The fear of God" fits a teacher who instructed the king, so it is followed here, but the printed reading, "who had understanding in the visions of God", is possible.

decisions.choice: seek God: turn to God in worship and trust
decisions.reason: To seek God, or seek Yahweh, is the mark of a faithful king in Chronicles (14:3; 15:12; 17:4). The verse twice ties Uzziah's success to his seeking, as the prophet told Asa: "if you seek him, he will be found by you" (15:2).

decisions.choice: Zechariah: a teacher of the king, otherwise unknown
decisions.reason: This Zechariah is not the prophet whose book is in the Bible, who lived after the exile, nor the priest killed under Joash (24:20-22). Like the priest Jehoiada for Joash (24:2), he guided the young king, and the verse implies that his influence waned or ended with his death.

decisions.choice: he was to seek God: he kept seeking, he set himself to seek
decisions.reason: The verb "to be" with "to seek" describes a settled course through a period of time: during Zechariah's days he made seeking God his practice.

decisions.choice: set himself to seek (Balanced); tried to follow, respect and obey (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the ongoing purpose (m4). Readable explains "seek" as following God and looking to him for help, and "the fear of God" as respecting and obeying him.

decisions.choice: "Se dedicó a buscar" (B); "procuró seguir" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the ongoing purpose (m4); Readable explains seeking God as following him, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "찾다" for seeking God, at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The key word of Chronicles keeps one Korean verb, as in 20:3-4 (m2); Readable says "따르다" and "의지하다".

decisions.choice: buscar (every level); que o instruía no temor de Deus (L, B); se dedicou a buscar (B)
alternatives: que entendia as visões de Deus
decisions.reason: "Buscar" is the book's key word for seeking God (m2), as 1:5 and 16:12 set it, kept even at Readable ("buscou a ajuda", as 16:12) where the English Readable says "looked to ... for help". Zechariah "o instruía no temor de Deus", the reading the English follows (m1); Readable says what that fear is, "respeitar e obedecer a Deus". Balanced's "se dedicou a buscar" gives the settled course of m4.

source.text: וַיֵּצֵא֙ וַיִּלָּ֣חֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיִּפְרֹ֞ץ אֶת־ח֣וֹמַת גַּ֗ת וְאֵת֙ חוֹמַ֣ת יַבְנֵ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת אַשְׁדּ֑וֹד וַיִּבְנֶ֣ה עָרִ֔ים בְּאַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וּבַפְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went out and fought against the Philistines and broke down [the] wall of Gath and [the] wall of Jabneh and [the] wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in Ashdod and among the Philistines.

en.L: And he went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath and the wall of Jabneh and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in Ashdod and among the Philistines.
en.B: He went out and made war on the Philistines, and broke down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. Then he built towns in the region of Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.
en.R: Uzziah went to war against the Philistines. He broke down the walls around the cities of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. Then he built towns of his own near Ashdod and in other parts of the Philistines' land.

es.L: Y salió y peleó contra los filisteos, y derribó el muro de Gat, y el muro de Jabne, y el muro de Asdod; y edificó ciudades en Asdod y entre los filisteos.
es.B: Salió a hacer la guerra contra los filisteos y derribó las murallas de Gat, de Jabne y de Asdod. Luego edificó ciudades en la región de Asdod y en otras partes entre los filisteos.
es.R: Uzías fue a la guerra contra los filisteos. Derribó las murallas que rodeaban las ciudades de Gat, Jabne y Asdod. Luego construyó ciudades propias cerca de Asdod y en otras partes del territorio de los filisteos.

fr.L: Et il sortit et combattit contre les Philistins, et il abattit la muraille de Gath, et la muraille de Yabné, et la muraille d’Ashdod ; et il bâtit des villes dans Ashdod et parmi les Philistins.
fr.B: Il partit faire la guerre aux Philistins, et il abattit les murailles de Gath, de Yabné et d’Ashdod. Puis il bâtit des villes dans la région d’Ashdod et ailleurs chez les Philistins.
fr.R: Ozias est parti en guerre contre les Philistins. Il a démoli les murailles des villes de Gath, de Yabné et d’Ashdod. Puis il a construit ses propres villes près d’Ashdod et dans d’autres parties du pays des Philistins.

sw.L: Akatoka, akapigana na Wafilisti, akaubomoa ukuta wa Gathi na ukuta wa Yabne na ukuta wa Ashdodi; akajenga miji katika Ashdodi na kati ya Wafilisti.
sw.B: Alitoka akapigana vita na Wafilisti, akabomoa kuta za Gathi, Yabne na Ashdodi. Kisha akajenga miji katika eneo la Ashdodi na mahali pengine kati ya Wafilisti.
sw.R: Uzia alikwenda kupigana vita na Wafilisti. Akabomoa kuta zilizozunguka miji ya Gathi, Yabne na Ashdodi. Kisha akajenga miji yake mwenyewe karibu na Ashdodi na katika sehemu nyingine za nchi ya Wafilisti.

vi.L: Vua đi ra giao chiến với người Phi-li-tin, phá đổ tường thành Gát, tường thành Giáp-nê và tường thành Ách-đốt; rồi vua xây các thành trong vùng Ách-đốt và giữa người Phi-li-tin.
vi.B: Vua ra đánh người Phi-li-tin, phá đổ tường thành Gát, Giáp-nê và Ách-đốt. Rồi vua xây các thành trong vùng Ách-đốt và những nơi khác giữa người Phi-li-tin.
vi.R: Ô-xia đi đánh người Phi-li-tin. Vua phá đổ tường bao quanh các thành Gát, Giáp-nê và Ách-đốt. Rồi vua xây những thành của mình gần Ách-đốt và ở những vùng khác trong đất của người Phi-li-tin.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 나가서 블레셋 사람들과 싸워, 가드 성벽과 야브네 성벽과 아스돗 성벽을 헐었다. 그리고 그가 아스돗과 블레셋 사람들 가운데에 성읍들을 건축했다.
ko.B: 그는 나가서 블레셋 사람들과 전쟁을 하여 가드와 야브네와 아스돗의 성벽을 헐었다. 그리고 아스돗 지역과 블레셋 사람들의 다른 땅에 성읍들을 건축했다.
ko.R: 웃시야는 블레셋 사람들과 전쟁을 했다. 그는 가드와 야브네와 아스돗 성읍을 둘러싼 성벽을 헐었다. 그리고 아스돗 근처와 블레셋 사람들의 땅 여러 곳에 자기 성읍들을 세웠다.

pt.L: E saiu e lutou contra os filisteus, e derrubou o muro de Gate, e o muro de Jabné, e o muro de Asdode; e edificou cidades em Asdode e entre os filisteus.
pt.B: Ele saiu à guerra contra os filisteus e derrubou os muros de Gate, de Jabné e de Asdode. Depois construiu cidades na região de Asdode e em outras partes do território dos filisteus.
pt.R: Uzias foi à guerra contra os filisteus. Ele derrubou os muros que cercavam as cidades de Gate, Jabné e Asdode. Depois construiu cidades suas perto de Asdode e em outras partes da terra dos filisteus.

decisions.choice: Gath, Jabneh, Ashdod: Philistine cities on Judah's western side
decisions.reason: Gath and Ashdod were among the five chief Philistine cities (1 Samuel 6:17). Jabneh, near the coast, is called Jabneel in Joshua 15:11. Breaking their walls left them open to Judah.

decisions.choice: built cities in Ashdod: fortified towns in Ashdod's territory
decisions.reason: "In Ashdod" here means in the land around the city of Ashdod. Uzziah built or fortified towns there to hold the region.

decisions.choice: the region of Ashdod (Balanced); near Ashdod, the Philistines' land (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "in Ashdod" means (m2). Readable names Uzziah and adds "the cities of" before the names.

decisions.choice: "Gat", "Jabne", "Asdod"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish forms of the Philistine cities.

decisions.choice: "Yabné", "Ashdod"
decisions.reason: Names in the French forms of these books, with y for the Hebrew y and "sh" as in "Ashdod" of French Samuel.

decisions.choice: Gate, Jabné, Asdode
decisions.reason: The Philistine cities (m1) keep the forms 1 Samuel 6:17 gives them in Portuguese, "Gate" and "Asdode". Jabneh is the town Joshua 15:11 calls "Jabneel", but Chronicles uses a shorter name, and the English follows it, so Portuguese writes "Jabné".

source.text: וַיַּעְזְרֵ֨הוּ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֜ים עַל־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים וְעַל־הָֽעַרְבִ֛ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בְּגוּר־בָּ֖עַל וְהַמְּעוּנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And helped him God against [the] Philistines and against the Arabs the [ones] dwelling in Gur-baal, and the Meunites.

en.L: And God helped him against [the] Philistines and against the Arabs who lived in Gur-baal, and the Meunites.
en.B: God helped him against the Philistines, against the Arabs who lived in Gur-baal, and against the Meunites.
en.R: God helped him fight the Philistines, the Arabs who lived in Gur-baal, and the Meunites.

es.L: Y Dios lo ayudó contra los filisteos, y contra los árabes que habitaban en Gur-baal, y los meunitas.
es.B: Dios lo ayudó contra los filisteos, contra los árabes que vivían en Gur-baal y contra los meunitas.
es.R: Dios lo ayudó a pelear contra los filisteos, contra los árabes que vivían en Gur-baal y contra los meunitas.

fr.L: Et Dieu l’aida contre les Philistins, et contre les Arabes qui habitaient à Gour-Baal, et les Méounites.
fr.B: Dieu l’aida contre les Philistins, contre les Arabes qui habitaient à Gour-Baal, et contre les Méounites.
fr.R: Dieu l’a aidé à combattre les Philistins, les Arabes qui habitaient à Gour-Baal, et les Méounites.

sw.L: Naye Mungu akamsaidia juu ya Wafilisti, na juu ya Waarabu waliokaa Gur-baali, na Wameuni.
sw.B: Mungu alimsaidia dhidi ya Wafilisti, dhidi ya Waarabu walioishi Gur-baali, na dhidi ya Wameuni.
sw.R: Mungu alimsaidia kupigana na Wafilisti, Waarabu walioishi Gur-baali, na Wameuni.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời giúp vua chống lại người Phi-li-tin, chống lại người A-rập sống tại Gu-rơ Ba-anh, và người Mê-u-nim.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời giúp vua chống lại người Phi-li-tin, người A-rập sống tại Gu-rơ Ba-anh, và người Mê-u-nim.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời giúp vua đánh người Phi-li-tin, người A-rập sống tại Gu-rơ Ba-anh, và người Mê-u-nim.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님께서 블레셋 사람들과 구르바알에 사는 아랍 사람들과 마온 사람들을 [치도록] 그를 도우셨다.
ko.B: 하나님께서는 그가 블레셋 사람들과 구르바알에 사는 아랍 사람들과 마온 사람들을 칠 때 그를 도우셨다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 웃시야가 블레셋 사람들과 구르바알에 사는 아랍 사람들과 마온 사람들과 싸울 때 그를 도우셨다.

pt.L: E Deus o ajudou contra os filisteus, e contra os árabes que habitavam em Gur-Baal, e os meunitas.
pt.B: Deus o ajudou contra os filisteus, contra os árabes que viviam em Gur-Baal e contra os meunitas.
pt.R: Deus o ajudou a lutar contra os filisteus, contra os árabes que viviam em Gur-Baal e contra os meunitas.

decisions.choice: God helped him: the help his name speaks of
decisions.reason: The verb "help" is the root of the name Azariah, "Yahweh has helped", by which Kings knows this king. Chronicles comes back to it in verses 13 and 15: his strength came from God's help.

decisions.choice: the Arabs who lived in Gur-baal: desert tribes to the south
decisions.reason: Arab tribes of the desert south of Judah also appear in 17:11 and 21:16. Gur-baal is not named anywhere else, and where it lay is unknown.

decisions.choice: the Meunites: a people of the region south of the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: The Meunites are named beside the people of Mount Seir, the land of Edom (1 Chronicles 4:41-42). The name may come from the town of Maon or a place called Maan.

decisions.choice: against the Meunites (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins "and the Meunites" without repeating "against"; Balanced repeats it so the list reads clearly. Readable says "helped him fight".

decisions.choice: "도우셨다" for the verb of help, kept in verses 13 and 15 ("돕다", "도움")
decisions.reason: The root of help runs through the chapter and lies behind the king's other name, Azariah (m1); one Korean verb keeps it visible.

decisions.choice: ajudar (every level, here and in verses 13 and 15); os meunitas; Gur-Baal
decisions.reason: "Ajudar" is used each time the chapter comes back to God's help (m1), in verses 13 and 15 too, so the Portuguese reader hears the word return as the Hebrew reader does. The people are "os meunitas", as 1 Chronicles 4:41 has them in Portuguese (m3); the place keeps its two parts, "Gur-Baal", with "Baal" spelled as Portuguese spells the god's name.

source.text: וַיִּתְּנ֧וּ הָֽעַמּוֹנִ֛ים מִנְחָ֖ה לְעֻזִּיָּ֑הוּ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁמוֹ֙ עַד־לְב֣וֹאמִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י הֶחֱזִ֖יק עַד־לְמָֽעְלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave the Ammonites tribute to Uzziah, and went his name as far as [the] entrance of Egypt, for he became strong to upward.

en.L: And the Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah, and his name went as far as the entrance of Egypt, for he became exceedingly strong.
en.B: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah, and his fame reached all the way to the border of Egypt, because he had grown very strong.
en.R: The Ammonites paid Uzziah taxes to show they were under his rule. People heard about him as far away as the border of Egypt, because he had become very powerful.

es.L: Y los amonitas dieron tributo a Uzías, y su nombre llegó hasta la entrada de Egipto, porque se hizo fuerte en gran manera.
es.B: Los amonitas le pagaban tributo a Uzías, y su fama llegó hasta la frontera de Egipto, porque se había hecho muy poderoso.
es.R: Los amonitas le pagaban impuestos a Uzías para mostrar que estaban bajo su dominio. La gente oyó hablar de él hasta en la frontera de Egipto, porque se había hecho muy poderoso.

fr.L: Et les Ammonites donnèrent un tribut à Ozias, et son nom alla jusqu’à l’entrée de l’Égypte, car il devint extrêmement fort.
fr.B: Les Ammonites apportèrent un tribut à Ozias, et sa renommée s’étendit jusqu’à la frontière de l’Égypte, car il était devenu très puissant.
fr.R: Les Ammonites ont payé des impôts à Ozias pour montrer qu’ils étaient sous son autorité. On a entendu parler de lui jusqu’à la frontière de l’Égypte, parce qu’il était devenu très puissant.

sw.L: Waamoni wakampa Uzia ushuru, na jina lake likaenea hata maingilio ya Misri, kwa maana alipata nguvu mno.
sw.B: Waamoni walimletea Uzia ushuru, na sifa zake zikaenea hadi mpakani mwa Misri, kwa sababu alikuwa amekuwa na nguvu sana.
sw.R: Waamoni walimlipa Uzia kodi kuonyesha kwamba walikuwa chini ya utawala wake. Watu walisikia habari zake hadi mpakani mwa Misri, kwa sababu alikuwa amekuwa na nguvu nyingi.

vi.L: Người Am-môn nộp cống cho Ô-xia, và danh tiếng vua lan đến tận lối vào Ai Cập, vì vua trở nên vô cùng hùng mạnh.
vi.B: Người Am-môn nộp cống cho Ô-xia, và danh tiếng vua vang đến tận biên giới Ai Cập, vì vua đã trở nên rất hùng mạnh.
vi.R: Người Am-môn nộp thuế cho Ô-xia để tỏ ra họ phục quyền vua. Người ta nghe nói về vua đến tận biên giới Ai Cập, vì vua đã trở nên rất hùng mạnh.

ko.L: 그리고 암몬 사람들이 웃시야에게 조공을 바쳤고, 그의 이름이 이집트 입구까지 퍼졌다. 그가 매우 강해졌기 때문이다.
ko.B: 암몬 사람들이 웃시야에게 조공을 바쳤고, 그의 명성은 이집트 국경에까지 퍼졌다. 그가 매우 강해졌기 때문이다.
ko.R: 암몬 사람들은 웃시야의 다스림을 받는다는 표시로 그에게 세금을 바쳤다. 웃시야의 소문은 멀리 이집트 국경에까지 퍼졌다. 그가 아주 강해졌기 때문이다.

pt.L: E os amonitas deram tributo a Uzias, e o seu nome foi até a entrada do Egito, porque ele se fortaleceu muitíssimo.
pt.B: Os amonitas trouxeram tributo a Uzias, e a sua fama chegou até a fronteira do Egito, porque ele tinha se tornado muito forte.
pt.R: Os amonitas pagavam impostos a Uzias para mostrar que estavam debaixo do seu domínio. Até na fronteira do Egito as pessoas ouviram falar dele, porque ele tinha se tornado muito poderoso.

decisions.choice: the Ammonites
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "the Meunites" here, which would continue the list of verse 7; the two names look alike in Hebrew. The Hebrew text is kept. Ammon lay east of the Jordan, and it paid tribute again to Uzziah's son Jotham (27:5).

decisions.choice: tribute: payment as a sign of submission
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for a gift or a grain offering; given by one nation to another king, it is tribute, the payment of a people under his rule (17:11; 2 Samuel 8:2).

decisions.choice: his name went: his fame spread
decisions.reason: A person's name stands for his reputation. "The entrance of Egypt" is the way into Egypt, its border in the south-west.

decisions.choice: strong to upward: exceedingly strong
decisions.reason: The phrase means "to a high degree", as in 16:12 and 17:12.

decisions.choice: taxes to show they were under his rule
decisions.reason: Readable explains what tribute was (m2) and says the idiom "his name went" plainly.

decisions.choice: tributo (L, B), impostos ... para mostrar que estavam debaixo do seu domínio (R); o seu nome (L), a sua fama (B)
decisions.reason: Paid by one nation to a king, the gift is tribute (m2), and Portuguese "tributo" says that plainly; "oferta" would make it an offering to God. Literal keeps "nome" for the king's reputation (m3), Balanced says "fama", and Readable puts both ideas into plain words, as the English does.

source.text: וַיִּ֨בֶן עֻזִּיָּ֤הוּ מִגְדָּלִים֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַל־שַׁ֧עַר הַפִּנָּ֛ה וְעַל־שַׁ֥עַר הַגַּ֖יְא וְעַל־הַמִּקְצ֑וֹעַ וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And built Uzziah towers in Jerusalem at [the] gate of the corner and at [the] gate of the valley and at the angle, and he strengthened them.

en.L: And Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate and at the Valley Gate and at the Angle, and he fortified them.
en.B: In Jerusalem Uzziah built towers at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate and the Angle, and he fortified them.
en.R: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem beside the Corner Gate, beside the Valley Gate and at the place where the wall turns, and he made them strong.

es.L: Y Uzías edificó torres en Jerusalén, en la puerta del Ángulo, y en la puerta del Valle, y en la Esquina, y las fortificó.
es.B: En Jerusalén, Uzías edificó torres en la puerta del Ángulo, en la puerta del Valle y en la Esquina, y las fortificó.
es.R: Uzías construyó torres en Jerusalén junto a la puerta del Ángulo, junto a la puerta del Valle y en el lugar donde la muralla hace un recodo, y las hizo fuertes.

fr.L: Et Ozias bâtit des tours à Jérusalem, à la porte de l’Angle, et à la porte de la Vallée, et à l’Encoignure, et il les fortifia.
fr.B: À Jérusalem, Ozias bâtit des tours à la porte de l’Angle, à la porte de la Vallée et à l’Encoignure, et il les fortifia.
fr.R: Ozias a construit des tours à Jérusalem, près de la porte de l’Angle, près de la porte de la Vallée et à l’endroit où la muraille fait un coude, et il les a rendues solides.

sw.L: Uzia akajenga minara katika Yerusalemu kwenye Lango la Pembeni na kwenye Lango la Bondeni na kwenye Pembe, akaiimarisha.
sw.B: Katika Yerusalemu Uzia alijenga minara kwenye Lango la Pembeni, Lango la Bondeni na Pembe, akaiimarisha.
sw.R: Uzia alijenga minara katika Yerusalemu karibu na Lango la Pembeni, karibu na Lango la Bondeni na mahali ukuta unapopinda, akaifanya imara.

vi.L: Ô-xia xây các tháp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, ở Cổng Góc, ở Cổng Thung Lũng và ở Góc Thành, và làm cho chúng kiên cố.
vi.B: Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, Ô-xia xây các tháp ở Cổng Góc, Cổng Thung Lũng và Góc Thành, và củng cố các tháp ấy.
vi.R: Ô-xia xây các tháp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, cạnh Cổng Góc, cạnh Cổng Thung Lũng và ở chỗ tường thành rẽ góc, rồi làm cho các tháp ấy vững chắc.

ko.L: 그리고 웃시야가 예루살렘에서 모퉁이 문과 골짜기 문과 성 모퉁이에 망대들을 건축하고 그것들을 견고하게 했다.
ko.B: 웃시야는 예루살렘의 모퉁이 문과 골짜기 문과 성 모퉁이에 망대들을 세우고 견고하게 했다.
ko.R: 웃시야는 예루살렘의 모퉁이 문 곁과 골짜기 문 곁과 성벽이 꺾이는 곳에 망대들을 세웠다. 그리고 그것들을 튼튼하게 만들었다.

pt.L: E Uzias edificou torres em Jerusalém, junto à Porta da Esquina, e junto à Porta do Vale, e junto ao Ângulo, e as fortificou.
pt.B: Em Jerusalém, Uzias construiu torres na Porta da Esquina, na Porta do Vale e no Ângulo, e as fortificou.
pt.R: Uzias construiu torres em Jerusalém ao lado da Porta da Esquina, ao lado da Porta do Vale e no lugar onde o muro faz uma curva, e as tornou fortes.

decisions.choice: the Corner Gate and the Valley Gate: gates in the walls of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The Corner Gate was at the north-west of the city; the wall between it and the Ephraim Gate had been broken down by Joash of Israel in Amaziah's day (25:23). The Valley Gate opened on the valley west and south of the city (Nehemiah 2:13; 3:13). Uzziah's towers repaired and strengthened the city's defenses.

decisions.choice: the Angle: a bend or buttress in the wall
decisions.reason: The word means a corner or turning. It names a place on the eastern wall near the palace in Nehemiah 3:19-25, where the line of the wall turned. Its exact place here is not certain.

decisions.choice: the place where the wall turns
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "the Angle" as a place name; Readable says what it was (m2).

decisions.choice: "la puerta del Ángulo", "la puerta del Valle", "la Esquina" (L, B); "donde la muralla hace un recodo" (R)
decisions.reason: The Corner Gate as in Spanish 2 Kings 14:13; Literal and Balanced keep "the Angle" as a place name, Readable says what it was (m2).

decisions.choice: "l'Encoignure"
decisions.reason: French already uses "la porte de l'Angle" for the Corner Gate (2 Kings 14:13); "l'Encoignure" keeps the bend in the wall distinct (m2). Readable says what it was.

decisions.choice: a Porta da Esquina, a Porta do Vale; o Ângulo (L, B), o lugar onde o muro faz uma curva (R)
decisions.reason: The Corner Gate keeps the name 2 Kings 14:13 gives it in Portuguese, "a Porta da Esquina" (m1), the gate whose wall Joash of Israel broke down; "a Porta do Vale" is the gate that opened on the valley. "O Ângulo" is kept as a place name at Literal and Balanced, as the English keeps "the Angle", and Readable says what it was (m2).

source.text: וַיִּ֨בֶן מִגְדָּלִ֜ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר וַיַּחְצֹב֙ בֹּר֣וֹת רַבִּ֔ים כִּ֤י מִקְנֶה־רַּב֙ הָ֣יָה ל֔וֹ וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּבַמִּישׁ֑וֹר אִכָּרִ֣ים וְכֹֽרְמִ֗ים בֶּהָרִים֙ וּבַכַּרְמֶ֔ל כִּֽי־אֹהֵ֥ב אֲדָמָ֖ה הָיָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he built towers in the wilderness and hewed cisterns many, for livestock much belonged to him; and in the Shephelah and in the plain, farmers and vinedressers in the mountains and in the fruitful land, for loving [the] ground he was.

en.L: And he built towers in the wilderness and cut out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, in the Shephelah and in the plain; [he had] farmers and vinedressers in the hills and in the fruitful land, for he was a lover of the soil.
en.B: He built towers in the wilderness and cut out many cisterns, for he had large herds in the Shephelah and on the plain. He had farmers and vinedressers working in the hill country and the fertile fields, for he loved the soil.
en.R: He built watchtowers in the desert and dug many large pits in the rock to hold water, because he had many cattle and sheep in the western foothills and on the high plain. He had people working his fields and his vineyards in the hills and in the good farmland, because he loved working the land.

es.L: Y edificó torres en el desierto, y excavó muchas cisternas, porque tenía mucho ganado, en la Sefela y en la llanura; [tenía] labradores y viñadores en los montes y en el campo fértil, porque era amante de la tierra.
es.B: Edificó torres en el desierto y excavó muchas cisternas, porque tenía grandes rebaños en la Sefela y en la llanura. Tenía labradores y viñadores que trabajaban en la región montañosa y en los campos fértiles, porque amaba la tierra.
es.R: Construyó torres de vigilancia en el desierto y cavó en la roca muchos pozos grandes para guardar agua, porque tenía mucho ganado en las colinas del oeste y en la meseta. Tenía gente que trabajaba sus campos y sus viñedos en los montes y en las tierras buenas para el cultivo, porque le encantaba cultivar la tierra.

fr.L: Et il bâtit des tours dans le désert et creusa de nombreuses citernes, car il avait beaucoup de bétail, dans la Shéphéla et dans la plaine ; [il avait] des laboureurs et des vignerons dans les montagnes et dans les terres fertiles, car il aimait la terre.
fr.B: Il bâtit des tours dans le désert et creusa de nombreuses citernes, car il avait de grands troupeaux dans la Shéphéla et dans la plaine. Il avait des laboureurs et des vignerons dans la région montagneuse et dans les terres fertiles, car il aimait la terre.
fr.R: Il a construit des tours de guet dans le désert et il a fait creuser dans la roche beaucoup de grands réservoirs pour garder l’eau, parce qu’il avait beaucoup de bétail dans les collines de l’ouest et sur le haut plateau. Il avait des gens qui travaillaient ses champs et ses vignes dans les collines et dans les bonnes terres, parce qu’il aimait cultiver la terre.

sw.L: Akajenga minara jangwani, akachimba visima vingi, kwa maana alikuwa na mifugo mingi, katika Shefela na katika nchi tambarare; [alikuwa na] wakulima na watunza mizabibu milimani na katika nchi yenye rutuba, kwa maana alikuwa mpenda ardhi.
sw.B: Alijenga minara jangwani, akachonga visima vingi, kwa sababu alikuwa na makundi makubwa ya mifugo katika Shefela na katika nchi tambarare. Alikuwa na wakulima na watunza mizabibu wakifanya kazi katika nchi ya milima na katika mashamba yenye rutuba, kwa sababu aliipenda ardhi.
sw.R: Alijenga minara ya ulinzi jangwani, akachimba mashimo mengi makubwa katika mwamba ili kuhifadhi maji, kwa sababu alikuwa na ng'ombe na kondoo wengi katika vilima vya magharibi na katika nchi tambarare ya juu. Alikuwa na watu waliofanya kazi katika mashamba yake na mizabibu yake milimani na katika ardhi nzuri ya kulima, kwa sababu alipenda kazi ya kulima.

vi.L: Vua cũng xây các tháp trong hoang mạc và đục nhiều hồ chứa nước, vì vua có nhiều gia súc ở vùng Sơ-phê-la và ở đồng bằng; [vua có] những người làm ruộng và những người trồng nho trên núi và trong vùng đất màu mỡ, vì vua yêu đất đai.
vi.B: Vua xây các tháp trong hoang mạc và đục nhiều hồ chứa nước, vì vua có những bầy gia súc lớn ở vùng Sơ-phê-la và trên cao nguyên. Vua có những người làm ruộng và trồng nho trong vùng đồi núi và những cánh đồng màu mỡ, vì vua yêu đất đai.
vi.R: Vua xây các tháp canh trong sa mạc và đục nhiều hố lớn trong đá để chứa nước, vì vua có nhiều bò và chiên ở vùng đồi phía tây và trên cao nguyên. Vua có người làm ruộng và trồng nho cho mình trên các đồi và trong những vùng đất tốt, vì vua thích làm nông.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 광야에 망대들을 건축하고 많은 물웅덩이를 팠다. 그에게 세펠라와 평지에 가축이 많았기 때문이다. 산지와 기름진 땅에 농부들과 포도원 일꾼들이 [있었다]. 그가 땅을 사랑하는 자였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그는 광야에 망대들을 세우고 물웅덩이를 많이 팠다. 세펠라와 평지에 그의 가축 떼가 많았기 때문이다. 또 산지와 기름진 밭에는 그의 농부들과 포도원 일꾼들이 있었다. 그가 땅을 사랑했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그는 광야에 망대들을 세우고, 바위를 파서 물을 모아 두는 웅덩이를 많이 만들었다. 서쪽 낮은 언덕 지대와 높은 평원에 그의 소 떼와 양 떼가 많았기 때문이다. 산지와 좋은 밭에서는 그의 밭과 포도원에서 일하는 사람들이 있었다. 그가 땅을 일구는 일을 좋아했기 때문이다.

pt.L: E edificou torres no deserto e cavou muitas cisternas, porque tinha muito gado, na Sefelá e na planície; [tinha] lavradores e vinhateiros nos montes e na terra fértil, porque ele era amante do solo.
pt.B: Ele construiu torres no deserto e cavou muitas cisternas, porque tinha grandes rebanhos na Sefelá e na planície. Tinha lavradores e vinhateiros trabalhando na região montanhosa e nos campos férteis, porque amava a terra.
pt.R: Ele construiu torres de vigia no deserto e cavou na rocha muitos poços grandes para guardar água, porque tinha muitos bois e ovelhas nas colinas do oeste e no planalto. Tinha gente trabalhando nas suas plantações e nas suas vinhas, nos montes e nas terras boas para plantar, porque ele gostava de cultivar a terra.

decisions.choice: towers and cisterns: watchtowers and water storage for herds
decisions.reason: In the dry south a tower guarded flocks and travelers, and a cistern cut into the rock stored the winter rain for the dry season. Remains of such towers and cisterns from the time of the kings have been found in the Negev.

decisions.choice: in the Shephelah and in the plain: where the livestock were kept
decisions.reason: The phrase most naturally belongs with the livestock just named. It could also begin the next clause, placing the farmers there as well.

decisions.choice: the Shephelah and the plain: the low hills west of Judah and the tableland east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: The Shephelah is the band of low hills between the hill country of Judah and the coastal plain (Joshua 15:33). "The plain" usually names the high tableland east of the Dead Sea (Deuteronomy 3:10), though it may mean any level ground.

decisions.choice: the fruitful land: garden land, not the mountain named Carmel
decisions.reason: The word is the same as the name of Mount Carmel, but it is also a common noun for fertile, cultivated land (Isaiah 29:17; Jeremiah 2:7). The northern Carmel lay in Israel, not Judah, so the common sense fits here.

decisions.choice: he loved the soil: he cared for farming
decisions.reason: The word for "soil" is the ground that is tilled (Genesis 2:5). The king took a personal interest in his farms and herds.

decisions.choice: [he had] (Literal); He had (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lists the farmers and vinedressers without a verb; English supplies "he had". Readable explains cisterns as pits in the rock for water and the Shephelah as the western foothills.

decisions.choice: "la Sefela" (L, B); "las colinas del oeste" (R); "la llanura" (L, B); "la meseta" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the region's name; Readable says where it was, as the English says "western foothills" and "high plain" (m3).

decisions.choice: "la Shéphéla"
decisions.reason: The name of the low hills west of Judah, kept as a name at Literal and Balanced as the English does; Readable says "les collines de l'ouest".

decisions.choice: Shefela (L, B); vilima vya magharibi (R)
decisions.reason: The low hills west of Judah keep their Hebrew name at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what the region is.

decisions.choice: "vùng Sơ-phê-la"
decisions.reason: The low hills west of Judah (m3) keep their Hebrew name at Literal and Balanced, as the English does; Readable says "vùng đồi phía tây".

decisions.choice: "기름진 땅" (Literal), "기름진 밭" (Balanced), "좋은 밭" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word is read as the common noun for fertile land, not Mount Carmel (m4); "세펠라" keeps the name used in the 1 Kings drafts.

decisions.choice: a Sefelá (L, B), as colinas do oeste (R); a planície (L, B), o planalto (R); a terra fértil (L), os campos férteis (B), as terras boas para plantar (R)
decisions.reason: "A Sefelá" is the name 1 Kings 10:27 and 1 Chronicles 27:28 use in Portuguese for the low hills (m3), and Readable calls them "as colinas do oeste", as 1 Chronicles 27:28 does. The word that is also the name of Mount Carmel means fertile land here (m4), so no level writes "Carmelo". Readable's "planalto" is the high tableland of m3, as the English Readable says "high plain".

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י לְעֻזִּיָּ֡הוּ חַיִל֩ עֹשֵׂ֨ה מִלְחָמָ֜ה יוֹצְאֵ֧י צָבָ֣א לִגְד֗וּד בְּמִסְפַּר֙ פְּקֻדָּתָ֔ם בְּיַד֙ יְעִיאֵ֣ל הַסּוֹפֵ֔ר וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ הַשּׁוֹטֵ֑ר עַ֚ל יַד־חֲנַנְיָ֔הוּ מִשָּׂרֵ֖י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And belonged to Uzziah an army doing war, going out [to the] army by band, by [the] number of their muster by [the] hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under [the] hand of Hananiah, of [the] commanders of the king.

en.L: And Uzziah had an army for making war, going out to war by bands, according to the number of their muster by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the official, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the commanders of the king.
en.B: Uzziah had an army ready for battle, which went out to war in divisions, according to the numbers in the muster made by Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the official, who worked under Hananiah, one of the king's commanders.
en.R: Uzziah had an army trained for battle. They went out to war in groups. Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the official had counted the soldiers and listed them in their groups. Hananiah, one of the king's commanders, was in charge of them.

es.L: Y tenía Uzías un ejército para hacer la guerra, que salía a la guerra por bandas, según el número de su censo hecho por mano de Jeiel el escriba y Maasías el oficial, bajo la mano de Hananías, uno de los jefes del rey.
es.B: Uzías tenía un ejército listo para la batalla, que salía a la guerra por divisiones, según el número del censo que habían hecho Jeiel el secretario y Maasías el oficial, bajo las órdenes de Hananías, uno de los jefes del rey.
es.R: Uzías tenía un ejército entrenado para la batalla. Salían a la guerra por grupos. Jeiel el secretario y Maasías el oficial habían contado a los soldados y los habían anotado por grupos. Hananías, uno de los jefes del rey, estaba a cargo de ellos.

fr.L: Et Ozias avait une armée pour faire la guerre, qui sortait en campagne par bandes, selon le nombre de leur recensement fait par la main de Yeïel le scribe et de Maaséya l’officier, sous la main de Hanania, l’un des chefs du roi.
fr.B: Ozias avait une armée prête au combat, qui partait à la guerre par divisions, selon les effectifs du recensement fait par Yeïel le secrétaire et Maaséya l’officier, sous l’autorité de Hanania, l’un des chefs du roi.
fr.R: Ozias avait une armée entraînée pour le combat. Les soldats partaient à la guerre par groupes. Yeïel le secrétaire et Maaséya l’officier avaient compté les soldats et les avaient inscrits dans leurs groupes. Hanania, l’un des chefs de l’armée du roi, les dirigeait.

sw.L: Uzia alikuwa na jeshi la kufanya vita, lililotoka kwenda vitani kwa vikosi, kwa hesabu yao walivyohesabiwa kwa mkono wa Yeieli mwandishi na Maaseya afisa, chini ya mkono wa Hanania, mmoja wa makamanda wa mfalme.
sw.B: Uzia alikuwa na jeshi lililokuwa tayari kwa vita, lililokwenda vitani kwa vikosi, kwa hesabu iliyofanywa na Yeieli katibu na Maaseya afisa, waliofanya kazi chini ya Hanania, mmoja wa makamanda wa mfalme.
sw.R: Uzia alikuwa na jeshi lililofunzwa kwa vita. Lilikwenda vitani kwa vikundi. Yeieli katibu na Maaseya afisa walikuwa wamewahesabu askari na kuwaandika katika vikundi vyao. Hanania, mmoja wa makamanda wa mfalme, ndiye aliyewasimamia.

vi.L: Ô-xia có một đạo quân để chiến đấu, ra trận theo từng toán, theo số đã kiểm tra bởi tay Giê-i-ên, thư ký, và Ma-a-sê-gia, quan chức, dưới tay Ha-na-nia, một trong các tướng của vua.
vi.B: Ô-xia có một đạo quân sẵn sàng chiến đấu, ra trận theo từng đơn vị, theo số quân do thư ký Giê-i-ên và quan chức Ma-a-sê-gia kiểm tra, dưới quyền Ha-na-nia, một trong các tướng của vua.
vi.R: Ô-xia có một đạo quân được huấn luyện để ra trận. Họ ra trận theo từng nhóm. Thư ký Giê-i-ên và quan chức Ma-a-sê-gia đã đếm và ghi tên binh lính theo nhóm. Ha-na-nia, một trong các tướng của vua, chỉ huy họ.

ko.L: 그리고 웃시야에게는 전쟁을 하는 군대가 있었는데, 서기관 여이엘과 관리 마아세야가 계수한 수에 따라 부대별로 군대에 나갔고, 왕의 지휘관들 가운데 하나인 하나냐의 지휘 아래 있었다.
ko.B: 웃시야에게는 싸울 준비가 된 군대가 있었다. 그들은 서기관 여이엘과 관리 마아세야가 조사한 인원수에 따라 부대별로 전쟁에 나갔고, 왕의 지휘관 가운데 하나인 하나냐의 지휘를 받았다.
ko.R: 웃시야에게는 싸울 준비가 된 군대가 있었다. 그들은 부대별로 전쟁에 나갔다. 서기관 여이엘과 관리 마아세야가 군인들의 수를 세어 부대별로 명단을 만들었다. 왕의 지휘관 가운데 하나인 하나냐가 그들을 지휘했다.

pt.L: E Uzias tinha um exército que fazia guerra, que saía para a guerra em tropas, segundo o número do seu recenseamento [feito] pela mão de Jeiel, o escrivão, e de Maaseias, o oficial, sob a mão de Hananias, um dos comandantes do rei.
pt.B: Uzias tinha um exército pronto para a batalha, que saía para a guerra em divisões, de acordo com o número do recenseamento feito por Jeiel, o secretário, e por Maaseias, o oficial, sob as ordens de Hananias, um dos comandantes do rei.
pt.R: Uzias tinha um exército treinado para a batalha. Os soldados iam para a guerra em grupos. Jeiel, o secretário, e Maaseias, o oficial, tinham contado os soldados e feito a lista dos seus grupos. Hananias, um dos comandantes do rei, era o responsável por eles.

decisions.choice: by bands: in organized units
decisions.reason: The word often means a raiding band, but here it names the units into which the army was divided for service.

decisions.choice: the scribe and the official: royal officials who kept the muster
decisions.reason: The scribe was a royal secretary who kept written records; the other was an official who helped organize the people and the army (Deuteronomy 20:5-9). Together they enrolled the soldiers.

decisions.choice: Jeiel: the name as the scribes marked it to be read
decisions.reason: The written text and the form marked to be read aloud spell this name slightly differently; both name the same man.

decisions.choice: by the hand of, under the hand of: carried out by, under the authority of
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for the person who acts and the one who directs: Jeiel and Maaseiah did the counting, under Hananiah's command.

decisions.choice: the scribe (Literal); the secretary (Balanced, Readable); the official; commanders
decisions.reason: As in Kings, Literal says "scribe" and Balanced and Readable "secretary" for the royal record-keeper. The second title is "official" at every level, as in Deuteronomy 16:18 and 2 Chronicles 19:11. The king's officers in a military setting are "commanders" at every level.

decisions.choice: "el escriba" (L); "el secretario" (B, R); "Jeiel", "Maasías", "Hananías"
decisions.reason: As in Spanish Kings, Literal says "escriba" and Balanced and Readable "secretario" for the royal record-keeper; the names in their usual Spanish forms.

decisions.choice: "le scribe" (Literal), "le secrétaire" (Balanced, Readable); "l'officier" at every level
decisions.reason: As French Kings for the royal record-keeper; "officier" for the second title, an official who kept the lists.

decisions.choice: mwandishi (L); katibu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The royal scribe is "mwandishi" at Literal and "katibu" (secretary) at Balanced and Readable, as the English and the terms note have it.

decisions.choice: "서기관" at every level for the royal scribe
decisions.reason: The title used for the king's scribe in the Kings drafts, where the English Balanced says "secretary".

decisions.choice: o escrivão (L), o secretário (B, R); o oficial (every level); Jeiel, Maaseias, Hananias
decisions.reason: The royal record-keeper is "o escrivão" at Literal and "o secretário" at Balanced and Readable, as 2 Kings 19:2 has it in Portuguese for Shebna (m2); the second title is "o oficial" at every level, as 19:11 has it in Portuguese. The names take the usual Portuguese "-ias" for names ending in the divine name, "Maaseias" and "Hananias".

source.text: כֹּ֠ל מִסְפַּ֞ר רָאשֵׁ֤י הָאָבוֹת֙ לְגִבּ֣וֹרֵי חָ֔יִל אַלְפַּ֖יִם וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] number of [the] heads of the fathers of mighty [men] of strength [was] two thousand and six hundred.

en.L: The whole number of the heads of the fathers' [houses], mighty men of valor, [was] 2,600.
en.B: The total number of family heads over the mighty warriors was 2,600.
en.R: There were 2,600 family leaders in charge of these brave warriors.

es.L: Todo el número de los jefes de [las casas de] los padres, valientes guerreros, [era] dos mil seiscientos.
es.B: El número total de jefes de familia al frente de los valientes guerreros era de dos mil seiscientos.
es.R: Había dos mil seiscientos jefes de familia a cargo de estos guerreros valientes.

fr.L: Le nombre total des chefs des [maisons des] pères, vaillants guerriers, [était] de deux mille six cents.
fr.B: Le nombre total des chefs de famille à la tête des vaillants guerriers était de deux mille six cents.
fr.R: Il y avait deux mille six cents chefs de famille à la tête de ces guerriers courageux.

sw.L: Hesabu yote ya vichwa vya [nyumba za] baba, mashujaa hodari, [ilikuwa] 2,600.
sw.B: Jumla ya wakuu wa jamaa waliosimamia mashujaa hodari ilikuwa 2,600.
sw.R: Kulikuwa na viongozi wa jamaa 2,600 waliosimamia mashujaa hao hodari.

vi.L: Tổng số các trưởng tộc, những dũng sĩ, [là] hai nghìn sáu trăm.
vi.B: Tổng số các trưởng gia tộc chỉ huy các dũng sĩ là 2.600 người.
vi.R: Có 2.600 người đứng đầu các gia đình chỉ huy những chiến binh dũng cảm này.

ko.L: 용맹한 용사들의 조상의 [집들의] 우두머리들의 모든 수는 2,600명[이었다].
ko.B: 용맹한 용사들을 거느린 가문의 우두머리들은 모두 2,600명이었다.
ko.R: 이 용감한 군인들을 거느린 집안의 지도자들은 2,600명이었다.

pt.L: Todo o número dos chefes das famílias, valentes guerreiros, [era] dois mil e seiscentos.
pt.B: O número total dos chefes das famílias que comandavam os guerreiros valentes era de dois mil e seiscentos.
pt.R: Havia dois mil e seiscentos líderes das famílias no comando desses guerreiros corajosos.

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers: leaders of the family groups
decisions.reason: The army was organized by families, and the heads of the father's houses led the men of their families (1 Chronicles 7:40).

decisions.choice: two thousand: the numbers as given
decisions.reason: On the size of numbers given in thousands, see the note at Numbers 1:21; here, as there, the text is read as giving the number.

decisions.choice: mighty men of valor: tried and able fighting men
decisions.reason: The phrase names strong, capable warriors, as in 13:3 and 14:7.

decisions.choice: over the mighty warriors (Balanced); in charge of (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew links the family heads and the warriors with a simple "of"; Balanced and Readable say that the heads led the warriors.

decisions.choice: os chefes das famílias (L, B), os líderes das famílias (R); valentes guerreiros (L), guerreiros valentes (B), guerreiros corajosos (R); dois mil e seiscentos
decisions.reason: The heads of the fathers' houses (m1) take the words 1:2 and 19:8 set for the book, and the mighty men of valor (m3) the words 1 Chronicles 7:2 and 12:9 use at each level. The count is a round number of hundreds, written in words as 2:1 writes "três mil e seiscentos".

source.text: וְעַל־יָדָם֩ חֵ֨יל צָבָ֜א שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֗לֶף וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת עוֹשֵׂ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּכֹ֣חַ חָ֑יִל לַעְזֹ֥ר לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל־הָאוֹיֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And under their hand [was the] force of [the] army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, doing war with power of strength, to help the king against the enemy.

en.L: And under their hand [was] an army force of 307,500, making war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
en.B: Under their command was an army of 307,500 men, a powerful fighting force ready to help the king against his enemies.
en.R: They commanded an army of 307,500 men. These soldiers fought with great strength and helped the king against his enemies.

es.L: Y bajo su mano [estaba] la fuerza del ejército, trescientos siete mil quinientos, que hacían la guerra con gran poder, para ayudar al rey contra el enemigo.
es.B: Bajo su mando había un ejército de trescientos siete mil quinientos hombres, una fuerza poderosa lista para ayudar al rey contra sus enemigos.
es.R: Ellos mandaban un ejército de trescientos siete mil quinientos hombres. Estos soldados peleaban con gran fuerza y ayudaban al rey contra sus enemigos.

fr.L: Et sous leur main [était] une force armée de 307 500 [hommes], faisant la guerre avec une grande puissance, pour aider le roi contre l’ennemi.
fr.B: Ils avaient sous leurs ordres une armée de 307 500 hommes, une force puissante, prête à aider le roi contre ses ennemis.
fr.R: Ils commandaient une armée de 307 500 hommes. Ces soldats combattaient avec une grande force et aidaient le roi contre ses ennemis.

sw.L: Na chini ya mkono wao [lilikuwa] jeshi la askari 307,500, waliofanya vita kwa nguvu kuu, ili kumsaidia mfalme dhidi ya adui.
sw.B: Chini ya amri yao kulikuwa na jeshi la watu 307,500, jeshi lenye nguvu, tayari kumsaidia mfalme dhidi ya adui zake.
sw.R: Waliongoza jeshi la watu 307,500. Askari hao walipigana kwa nguvu nyingi, wakamsaidia mfalme dhidi ya adui zake.

vi.L: Dưới tay họ [có] một lực lượng quân đội ba trăm lẻ bảy nghìn năm trăm người, chiến đấu với sức mạnh lớn lao, để giúp vua chống lại kẻ thù.
vi.B: Dưới quyền họ có một đạo quân 307.500 người, một lực lượng chiến đấu hùng mạnh, sẵn sàng giúp vua chống lại kẻ thù.
vi.R: Họ chỉ huy một đạo quân 307.500 người. Những binh lính này chiến đấu rất mạnh mẽ và giúp vua chống lại kẻ thù.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 손 아래에 307,500명의 군대가 있었는데, 그들은 큰 힘으로 전쟁을 하여 원수에 맞서 왕을 도왔다.
ko.B: 그들의 지휘 아래 307,500명의 군대가 있었다. 그들은 강력한 전투 부대로서 원수들에 맞서 왕을 도울 준비가 되어 있었다.
ko.R: 그들은 307,500명의 군대를 지휘했다. 이 군인들은 큰 힘으로 싸웠고, 원수들에 맞서 왕을 도왔다.

pt.L: E sob a mão deles [estava] uma força de exército de 307.500, que faziam guerra com força poderosa, para ajudar o rei contra o inimigo.
pt.B: Sob o comando deles havia um exército de 307.500 homens, uma força poderosa pronta para ajudar o rei contra os seus inimigos.
pt.R: Eles comandavam um exército de 307.500 homens. Esses soldados lutavam com grande força e ajudavam o rei contra os seus inimigos.

decisions.choice: thousand: the numbers as given
decisions.reason: As in verse 12: on the size of numbers given in thousands, see the note at Numbers 1:21.

decisions.choice: to help the king: the word of help again
decisions.reason: The army's task is put in the word that runs through this chapter (verses 7 and 15) and lies behind the king's other name, Azariah. God helped Uzziah, and his army was there to help him too.

decisions.choice: under their hand: under their command
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for authority: the family heads of verse 12 led these troops.

decisions.choice: men; his enemies
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "men" to the total, as in 14:7, and say "his enemies" for "the enemy", meaning any enemy who came against him.

decisions.choice: 307.500 in figures; ajudar
decisions.reason: A long count that is not round is written in figures, with the point Portuguese uses for thousands, as 2:16 writes "153.600". The army's task is "ajudar", the chapter's word of help (m2), as in verses 7 and 15.

source.text: וַיָּכֶן֩ לָהֶ֨ם עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ לְכָל־הַצָּבָ֗א מָגִנִּ֤ים וּרְמָחִים֙ וְכ֣וֹבָעִ֔ים וְשִׁרְיֹנ֖וֹת וּקְשָׁת֑וֹת וּלְאַבְנֵ֖י קְלָעִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And prepared for them Uzziah, for all the army, shields and spears and helmets and coats of mail and bows and for stones of slings.

en.L: And Uzziah prepared for them, for all the army, shields and spears and helmets and coats of mail and bows and stones for slings.
en.B: Uzziah provided the whole army with shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows and stones for slinging.
en.R: Uzziah gave the whole army shields, spears and helmets, armor to protect their bodies, bows, and stones to throw with slings.

es.L: Y Uzías preparó para ellos, para todo el ejército, escudos, y lanzas, y cascos, y cotas de malla, y arcos, y piedras para hondas.
es.B: Uzías proveyó a todo el ejército de escudos, lanzas, cascos, cotas de malla, arcos y piedras para las hondas.
es.R: Uzías le dio a todo el ejército escudos, lanzas y cascos, armaduras para proteger el cuerpo, arcos, y piedras para lanzarlas con hondas.

fr.L: Et Ozias prépara pour eux, pour toute l’armée, des boucliers, et des lances, et des casques, et des cuirasses, et des arcs, et des pierres de fronde.
fr.B: Ozias fournit à toute l’armée des boucliers, des lances, des casques, des cuirasses, des arcs et des pierres de fronde.
fr.R: Ozias a donné à toute l’armée des boucliers, des lances et des casques, des cuirasses pour protéger le corps, des arcs et des pierres à lancer avec la fronde.

sw.L: Uzia akawaandalia, kwa ajili ya jeshi lote, ngao na mikuki na kofia za chuma na dirii na pinde na mawe ya kombeo.
sw.B: Uzia aliwapa jeshi lote ngao, mikuki, kofia za chuma, dirii, pinde na mawe ya kutupa kwa kombeo.
sw.R: Uzia aliwapa jeshi lote ngao, mikuki na kofia za chuma, mavazi ya chuma ya kulinda miili yao, pinde, na mawe ya kutupa kwa kombeo.

vi.L: Ô-xia chuẩn bị cho họ, cho cả đạo quân, khiên, giáo, mũ sắt, áo giáp, cung, và đá để bắn ná.
vi.B: Ô-xia trang bị cho cả đạo quân khiên, giáo, mũ sắt, áo giáp, cung và đá để bắn ná.
vi.R: Ô-xia phát cho cả đạo quân khiên, giáo, mũ sắt, áo giáp để che thân, cung, và đá để ném bằng ná.

ko.L: 그리고 웃시야가 그들, 곧 온 군대를 위해 방패와 창과 투구와 갑옷과 활과 물맷돌을 준비했다.
ko.B: 웃시야는 온 군대에게 방패와 창과 투구와 갑옷과 활과 물맷돌을 마련해 주었다.
ko.R: 웃시야는 온 군대에게 방패와 창과 투구를 주었다. 몸을 보호하는 갑옷과 활도 주었고, 물매로 던질 돌들도 주었다.

pt.L: E Uzias preparou para eles, para todo o exército, escudos, e lanças, e capacetes, e couraças, e arcos, e pedras para fundas.
pt.B: Uzias equipou todo o exército com escudos, lanças, capacetes, couraças, arcos e pedras para atirar com funda.
pt.R: Uzias deu a todo o exército escudos, lanças e capacetes, armaduras para proteger o corpo, arcos e pedras para atirar com fundas.

decisions.choice: Uzziah prepared for all the army: weapons supplied by the king
decisions.reason: In earlier times soldiers often brought their own weapons (Judges 20:16; 1 Samuel 13:19-22). Here the king arms the whole army from his own stores, a sign of his wealth and strength.

decisions.choice: shields; coats of mail
decisions.reason: The shield here is the smaller round shield (14:7). The coat of mail was body armor made of small plates or scales, like Goliath's (1 Samuel 17:5, 38).

decisions.choice: stones for slings: stones shaped or chosen for slinging
decisions.reason: The sling was a strip of leather or cloth used to hurl stones with great force and accuracy (Judges 20:16; 1 Samuel 17:40). Stones made ready for it were part of an army's stores.

decisions.choice: armor to protect their bodies
decisions.reason: Readable says what a coat of mail was.

decisions.choice: couraças (L, B), armaduras para proteger o corpo (R); pedras para fundas (L), para atirar com funda (B, R)
decisions.reason: The coat of mail (m2) is "couraça", the word 1 Samuel 17:5 uses for Goliath's armour in Portuguese; "cota de malha" would suggest the woven rings of medieval armour, not scales or plates. The sling is "funda", as 1 Chronicles 12:2 has it in Portuguese (m3).

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ׀בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם חִשְּׁבֹנ֜וֹת מַחֲשֶׁ֣בֶת חוֹשֵׁ֗ב לִהְי֤וֹת עַל־הַמִּגְדָּלִים֙ וְעַל־הַפִּנּ֔וֹת לִירוֹא֙ בַּֽחִצִּ֔ים וּבָאֲבָנִ֖ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת וַיֵּצֵ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ עַד־לְמֵ֣רָח֔וֹק כִּֽי־הִפְלִ֥יא לְהֵעָזֵ֖ר עַ֥ד כִּֽי־חָזָֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made in Jerusalem devices, [the] device of [a] deviser, to be on the towers and on the corners, to shoot with arrows and with stones great; and went out his name as far as to from afar, for he made wonderful to be helped until that he was strong.

en.L: And he made in Jerusalem devices, the invention of an inventor, to be on the towers and on the corners, to shoot arrows and great stones. And his name went out as far as to a distance, for he was marvelously helped until he was strong.
en.B: In Jerusalem he made devices designed by skilled inventors, to be set on the towers and the corners of the walls for shooting arrows and large stones. His fame spread far and wide, for he was wonderfully helped until he became strong.
en.R: In Jerusalem he had skilled men design new kinds of equipment for war. These were put on the towers and the corners of the walls, so that soldiers could shoot arrows and throw large stones from them. People in faraway places heard about Uzziah. God helped him in wonderful ways until he became very powerful.

es.L: E hizo en Jerusalén máquinas, invención de inventor, para que estuvieran en las torres y en las esquinas, para lanzar flechas y grandes piedras. Y su nombre salió hasta lejos, porque fue ayudado maravillosamente hasta que se hizo fuerte.
es.B: En Jerusalén hizo máquinas diseñadas por hábiles inventores, para colocarlas en las torres y en las esquinas de las murallas y lanzar desde ellas flechas y grandes piedras. Su fama se extendió por todas partes, porque fue ayudado de manera maravillosa hasta que llegó a ser poderoso.
es.R: En Jerusalén hizo que hombres hábiles diseñaran nuevos aparatos de guerra. Los pusieron en las torres y en las esquinas de las murallas, para que los soldados pudieran disparar flechas y lanzar grandes piedras desde ellas. La gente de lugares lejanos oyó hablar de Uzías. Dios lo ayudó de maneras maravillosas hasta que llegó a ser muy poderoso.

fr.L: Et il fit à Jérusalem des machines, invention d’un inventeur, pour être sur les tours et sur les angles, pour lancer des flèches et de grosses pierres. Et son nom se répandit au loin, car il fut merveilleusement aidé jusqu’à ce qu’il fût fort.
fr.B: À Jérusalem, il fit fabriquer des machines conçues par des inventeurs habiles, qu’on plaça sur les tours et aux angles des murailles pour lancer des flèches et de grosses pierres. Sa renommée s’étendit au loin, car il fut merveilleusement aidé jusqu’à ce qu’il devienne puissant.
fr.R: À Jérusalem, il a fait inventer par des hommes habiles de nouvelles machines de guerre. On les a placées sur les tours et aux angles des murailles, pour que les soldats puissent tirer des flèches et lancer de grosses pierres. On a entendu parler d’Ozias jusque dans des pays lointains. Dieu l’a aidé de manière merveilleuse jusqu’à ce qu’il devienne très puissant.

sw.L: Akatengeneza katika Yerusalemu mitambo, ubunifu wa mbunifu, iwe juu ya minara na juu ya pembe, ili kupiga mishale na mawe makubwa. Na jina lake likaenea hata mbali, kwa maana alisaidiwa kwa ajabu mpaka akawa na nguvu.
sw.B: Katika Yerusalemu alitengeneza mitambo iliyobuniwa na wabunifu stadi, ili iwekwe juu ya minara na pembe za kuta kwa ajili ya kurusha mishale na mawe makubwa. Sifa zake zikaenea mbali sana, kwa maana alisaidiwa kwa ajabu mpaka akawa na nguvu.
sw.R: Katika Yerusalemu aliwaagiza watu stadi wabuni vifaa vipya vya vita. Viliwekwa juu ya minara na pembe za kuta, ili askari waweze kurusha mishale na mawe makubwa kutoka huko. Watu wa nchi za mbali walisikia habari za Uzia. Mungu alimsaidia kwa njia za ajabu mpaka akawa na nguvu nyingi.

vi.L: Vua làm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem những khí cụ do người tài khéo sáng chế, đặt trên các tháp và các góc thành để bắn tên và đá lớn. Danh tiếng vua đồn ra xa, vì vua được giúp đỡ cách lạ lùng cho đến khi vua trở nên hùng mạnh.
vi.B: Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, vua cho làm những khí cụ do các nhà sáng chế khéo léo thiết kế, đặt trên các tháp và các góc tường thành để bắn tên và đá lớn. Danh tiếng vua vang xa, vì vua được giúp đỡ cách lạ lùng cho đến khi trở nên hùng mạnh.
vi.R: Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, vua cho những người khéo tay thiết kế các loại khí cụ chiến tranh mới. Những khí cụ này được đặt trên các tháp và các góc tường thành, để binh lính bắn tên và ném đá lớn từ đó. Người ở những nơi xa xôi đều nghe nói về Ô-xia. Đức Chúa Trời đã giúp vua cách lạ lùng cho đến khi vua trở nên rất hùng mạnh.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 예루살렘에서 고안자가 고안한 장치들을 만들어, 망대들과 모퉁이들 위에 두어 화살과 큰 돌을 쏘게 했다. 그리고 그의 이름이 멀리까지 퍼졌다. 그가 놀랍게 도움을 받아 강해졌기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그는 예루살렘에서 솜씨 좋은 기술자들이 고안한 장치들을 만들어, 망대들과 성벽 모퉁이들 위에 두고 화살과 큰 돌을 쏘게 했다. 그의 명성은 멀리까지 퍼졌다. 그가 놀라운 도움을 받아 강해졌기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그는 예루살렘에서 솜씨 좋은 사람들에게 새로운 전쟁 장비를 만들게 했다. 그 장비를 망대들과 성벽 모퉁이에 두어, 군인들이 그것으로 화살을 쏘고 큰 돌을 던질 수 있게 했다. 먼 곳에 사는 사람들까지 웃시야에 대해 들었다. 하나님께서 그를 놀랍게 도우셔서 그가 아주 강해졌다.

pt.L: E fez em Jerusalém engenhos, invenção de inventor, para estarem sobre as torres e sobre as esquinas, para atirar flechas e grandes pedras. E o seu nome saiu até longe, porque ele foi maravilhosamente ajudado até que se fortaleceu.
pt.B: Em Jerusalém ele fez máquinas projetadas por inventores habilidosos, para ficarem nas torres e nas esquinas dos muros, a fim de atirar flechas e pedras grandes. A sua fama se espalhou para longe, porque ele foi ajudado de modo maravilhoso, até se tornar forte.
pt.R: Em Jerusalém ele mandou homens habilidosos projetarem novos tipos de equipamento de guerra. Esses equipamentos foram colocados nas torres e nas esquinas dos muros, para que os soldados pudessem atirar flechas e lançar pedras grandes de cima deles. Pessoas que moravam em lugares distantes ouviram falar de Uzias. Deus o ajudou de modo maravilhoso, até que ele se tornou muito poderoso.

decisions.choice: devices, the invention of an inventor: some new kind of defense on the walls
alternatives: engines that shot arrows and threw stones
decisions.reason: The three words come from one root meaning "to think out, devise", and stress the cleverness of the work. What the devices were is not certain. They may have been machines that shot arrows and hurled stones, or frames and shields built out from the battlements, from behind which defenders could shoot arrows and drop or throw stones on attackers below.

decisions.choice: he made wonderful to be helped: he was helped in a wonderful way
decisions.reason: The verb "make wonderful" with "to be helped" means that his help was extraordinary. The one who helped is not named here, but verse 7 has said it: God helped him.

decisions.choice: until he was strong: the turning point of the reign
decisions.reason: "Until" marks a limit. The help lasted until he became strong, and the next verse begins with his strength: "when he was strong" his heart grew proud. The words "help" and "strength" also echo his two names, Azariah and Uzziah.

decisions.choice: his name went out to a distance: his fame spread far
decisions.reason: As in verse 8, "name" means reputation.

decisions.choice: God helped him
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the helper, as verse 7 does (m2), and turns the devices into equipment that skilled men designed and soldiers used.

decisions.choice: "Dios lo ayudó"
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the helper, as verse 7 does (m2), following the English Readable.

decisions.choice: engenhos, invenção de inventor (L); máquinas projetadas por inventores habilidosos (B); novos tipos de equipamento de guerra (R)
decisions.reason: The three words of one root (m1) are "engenhos", "invenção" and "inventor" at Literal, so the play on devising can still be heard; Balanced says "máquinas", the old sense of "engenho" in plain modern words. No level says "catapultas", since what the devices were is not certain (m1).

decisions.choice: foi maravilhosamente ajudado (L), foi ajudado de modo maravilhoso (B), Deus o ajudou (R); até que se fortaleceu
