decisions.reason: The passive keeps the helper unnamed at Literal and Balanced, as the Hebrew does (m2), with "ajudar", the chapter's word of help; Readable names God, as the English does. "Até" marks the limit (m3), and "se fortaleceu" (L) / "se tornar forte" (B) uses the verb verse 16 picks up.

source.text: וּכְחֶזְקָת֗וֹ גָּבַ֤הּ לִבּוֹ֙ עַד־לְהַשְׁחִ֔ית וַיִּמְעַ֖ל בַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לְהַקְטִ֖יר עַל־מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And as his being strong was high his heart to destroy, and he acted unfaithfully against Yahweh his God, and he went into [the] temple of Yahweh to make smoke on [the] altar of the incense.

en.L: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, to [his] destruction, and he acted unfaithfully against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, and went into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to burn incense on the altar of incense.
en.B: But when he had become strong, his heart grew proud, to his own ruin. He was unfaithful to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, and he went into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to burn incense on the incense altar.
en.R: But once Uzziah became powerful, he grew proud, and that led to his ruin. He was unfaithful to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God. He went into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to burn incense on the incense altar himself.

es.L: Pero cuando se hizo fuerte, su corazón se enalteció para [su] ruina, y obró con infidelidad contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, y entró en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para quemar incienso sobre el altar del incienso.
es.B: Pero cuando llegó a ser poderoso, su corazón se llenó de orgullo, para su propia ruina. Fue infiel {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios, y entró en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para quemar incienso en el altar del incienso.
es.R: Pero cuando Uzías se hizo poderoso, se llenó de orgullo, y eso lo llevó a la ruina. Fue infiel {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios. Entró en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para quemar incienso en el altar del incienso él mismo.

fr.L: Mais quand il fut fort, son cœur s’éleva, pour [sa] perte, et il fut infidèle envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu, et il entra dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour brûler de l’encens sur l’autel de l’encens.
fr.B: Mais quand il fut devenu puissant, son cœur s’enorgueillit, pour sa propre perte. Il fut infidèle envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu, et il entra dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour brûler de l’encens sur l’autel des parfums.
fr.R: Mais quand Ozias est devenu puissant, il est devenu orgueilleux, et cela l’a mené à sa perte. Il a été infidèle {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} son Dieu. Il est entré dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour brûler lui-même de l’encens sur l’autel des parfums.

sw.L: Lakini alipokuwa na nguvu, moyo wake ukainuka, kwa maangamizi [yake], naye akakosa uaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, akaingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kufukiza uvumba juu ya madhabahu ya uvumba.
sw.B: Lakini alipokwisha kuwa na nguvu, moyo wake ukajaa kiburi, hata akaangamia. Hakuwa mwaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, akaingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kufukiza uvumba juu ya madhabahu ya uvumba.
sw.R: Lakini Uzia alipokuwa na nguvu, akawa na kiburi, na kiburi hicho kikamwangamiza. Hakuwa mwaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake. Aliingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili yeye mwenyewe afukize uvumba juu ya madhabahu ya uvumba.

vi.L: Nhưng khi vua đã hùng mạnh, lòng vua kiêu ngạo, đến nỗi bị hủy hoại, và vua bất trung với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời mình, mà vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để đốt hương trên bàn thờ xông hương.
vi.B: Nhưng khi đã hùng mạnh, lòng vua trở nên kiêu ngạo, đưa vua đến chỗ hủy hoại. Vua bất trung với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời mình, và vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để đốt hương trên bàn thờ xông hương.
vi.R: Nhưng khi Ô-xia đã hùng mạnh, vua trở nên kiêu ngạo, và điều đó dẫn vua đến chỗ hủy hoại. Vua bất trung với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời mình. Vua tự mình vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để đốt hương trên bàn thờ xông hương.

ko.L: 그러나 그가 강해지자, 그의 마음이 높아져 멸망에 이르렀다. 그가 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 신의를 저버리고, 분향단 위에 분향하려고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 들어갔다.
ko.B: 그러나 그는 강해지자 마음이 교만해져서 스스로 멸망을 불렀다. 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 신의를 저버렸다. 그는 분향단에 분향하려고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 들어갔다.
ko.R: 그러나 웃시야는 강해지자 교만해졌고, 그 교만이 그를 망하게 했다. 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 신실하지 못했다. 그는 분향단에 직접 향을 피우려고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 들어갔다.

pt.L: Mas, quando ele se fortaleceu, o seu coração se exaltou, para a [sua] ruína, e ele cometeu infidelidade contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, e entrou no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para queimar incenso sobre o altar do incenso.
pt.B: Mas, quando ele se tornou forte, o seu coração se encheu de orgulho, para a sua própria ruína. Ele foi infiel {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, e entrou no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para queimar incenso no altar do incenso.
pt.R: Mas, quando ficou poderoso, Uzias se tornou orgulhoso, e isso o levou à ruína. Ele foi infiel {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus. Entrou no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para queimar ele mesmo incenso no altar do incenso.

decisions.choice: his heart was high: he became proud
decisions.reason: A high heart is pride (Proverbs 16:5, 18; Ezekiel 28:2, 5). The same words are used of Jehoshaphat in a good sense, "his heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahweh", meaning he took courage in them (17:6). Here they mean arrogance, as with Hezekiah later (32:25).

decisions.choice: to destroy: to his ruin
decisions.reason: The verb means to ruin or destroy, and also to act corruptly. The phrase can mean his pride led to his own destruction, or that it went so far that he acted corruptly. The first fits the story that follows.

decisions.choice: acted unfaithfully: broke faith with God
decisions.reason: This verb is a key word of Chronicles for breaking faith with God, used of Saul (1 Chronicles 10:13) and of Judah before the exile (1 Chronicles 9:1; 2 Chronicles 36:14). It describes taking what belongs to God, here the holy service kept for the priests.

decisions.choice: the temple; the altar of incense: the main hall of the house of God
decisions.reason: The altar of incense stood in the main hall, in front of the most holy place. Only priests of Aaron's line might burn incense on it, morning and evening (Exodus 30:1-10). When others tried to offer incense, judgment fell (Numbers 16:35; 17:5).

decisions.choice: Uzziah; himself
decisions.reason: Readable names the king, says "grew proud" for the picture of a high heart, and adds "himself" to show that the king meant to do the priests' work, which verse 18 makes plain.

decisions.choice: "el templo del SEÑOR" (every level)
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew has the word for the temple hall itself, not "the house", so every level says "templo", as the English does (m4).

decisions.choice: "le temple" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has *hekhal*, the main hall of the temple (m4), not "house"; as French 2 Kings, it is "temple" at every level.

decisions.choice: "đền thờ" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here is *hekhal*, the temple hall itself (m4), not "the house of the LORD", so every level says "đền thờ".

decisions.choice: "신의를 저버리다" for acting unfaithfully (*ma'al*)
decisions.reason: The key word of Chronicles for breaking faith with God (m3) is given one phrase, as it returns at verse 18; Readable says "신실하지 못했다".

decisions.choice: o seu coração se exaltou (L), se encheu de orgulho (B), se tornou orgulhoso (R); cometeu infidelidade contra (L), foi infiel a (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the high heart (m1) with "se exaltou", which in Portuguese also says pride; Balanced and Readable say it plainly. The breach of faith (m3) takes the words 12:2 and 1 Chronicles 10:13 use in Portuguese, "cometer infidelidade contra" at Literal and "ser infiel a" at Balanced and Readable, so the reader hears the Chronicler's key word.

decisions.choice: o templo; o altar do incenso
decisions.reason: "Templo" here is the main hall of the house of God (m4), where the English too says "temple"; "o altar do incenso" is the name 1 Chronicles 6:34 and 28:18 give it in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֥א אַחֲרָ֖יו עֲזַרְיָ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְעִמּ֞וֹ כֹּהֲנִ֧ים׀לַיהוָ֛ה שְׁמוֹנִ֖ים בְּנֵי־חָֽיִל׃

records.literal_gloss: And went after him Azariah the priest, and with him priests of Yahweh, eighty, sons of strength.

en.L: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him [were] priests of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, eighty, men of valor.
en.B: Azariah the priest went in after him, along with eighty priests of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, men of courage.
en.R: Azariah the priest went in after him, together with eighty other priests of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They were brave men.

es.L: Y entró tras él el sacerdote Azarías, y con él ochenta sacerdotes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, hombres valientes.
es.B: El sacerdote Azarías entró tras él, junto con ochenta sacerdotes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, hombres valientes.
es.R: El sacerdote Azarías entró tras él, junto con otros ochenta sacerdotes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Eran hombres valientes.

fr.L: Et le prêtre Azaria entra après lui, et avec lui des prêtres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, quatre-vingts, hommes vaillants.
fr.B: Le prêtre Azaria entra après lui, avec quatre-vingts prêtres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, des hommes courageux.
fr.R: Le prêtre Azaria est entré après lui, avec quatre-vingts autres prêtres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. C’étaient des hommes courageux.

sw.L: Azaria kuhani akaingia nyuma yake, na pamoja naye makuhani wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, themanini, watu hodari.
sw.B: Azaria kuhani aliingia nyuma yake, pamoja na makuhani themanini wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu jasiri.
sw.R: Azaria kuhani aliingia nyuma yake, pamoja na makuhani wengine themanini wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walikuwa watu jasiri.

vi.L: Thầy tế lễ A-xa-ria đi vào theo vua, cùng với tám mươi thầy tế lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, những người can đảm.
vi.B: Thầy tế lễ A-xa-ria đi vào theo vua, cùng với tám mươi thầy tế lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là những người can đảm.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ A-xa-ria đi vào theo vua, cùng với tám mươi thầy tế lễ khác của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ là những người can đảm.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장 아사랴가 그의 뒤를 따라 들어갔고, 그와 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제사장들, 용감한 사람들 80명이 [있었다].
ko.B: 제사장 아사랴가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제사장 80명과 함께 그의 뒤를 따라 들어갔는데, 그들은 용감한 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 제사장 아사랴가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 다른 제사장 80명과 함께 그의 뒤를 따라 들어갔다. 그들은 용감한 사람들이었다.

pt.L: E Azarias, o sacerdote, entrou atrás dele, e com ele [estavam] sacerdotes {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, oitenta, homens valentes.
pt.B: Azarias, o sacerdote, entrou atrás dele, junto com oitenta sacerdotes {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, homens corajosos.
pt.R: Azarias, o sacerdote, entrou atrás dele com outros oitenta sacerdotes {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Eles eram homens corajosos.

decisions.choice: Azariah the priest: not the king
decisions.reason: This Azariah is the chief priest (verse 20). His name is the one Kings uses for King Uzziah (2 Kings 15:1), but here it names the priest who stands against the king. Which Azariah of the priestly line he was is not certain (compare 1 Chronicles 5:36-40).

decisions.choice: sons of strength: brave, able men
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of warriors (1 Samuel 18:17), but here it means men of courage. It took courage to oppose a powerful king; under Joash a priest who spoke out had been stoned (24:20-22).

decisions.choice: other
decisions.reason: Readable adds "other" so it is clear the eighty went in with Azariah.

decisions.choice: Azarias, o sacerdote; homens valentes (L), homens corajosos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The priest is "Azarias", the name Kings gives the king in Portuguese (m1); since the king is "Uzias" in this book, the two are not confused. "Sons of strength" is courage here, not warfare (m2): "valentes" at Literal, "corajosos" at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וַיַּעַמְד֞וּ עַל־עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לוֹ֙ לֹא־לְךָ֣ עֻזִּיָּ֗הוּ לְהַקְטִיר֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֣י לַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים בְּנֵי־אַהֲרֹ֛ן הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֖ים לְהַקְטִ֑יר צֵ֤א מִן־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ כִּ֣י מָעַ֔לְתָּ וְלֹֽא־לְךָ֥ לְכָב֖וֹד מֵיְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they stood against Uzziah the king and said to him, Not to you, Uzziah, to make smoke to Yahweh, for to the priests, [the] sons of Aaron, the [ones] consecrated to make smoke; go out from the sanctuary, for you have acted unfaithfully, and not to you for honor from Yahweh God.

en.L: And they stood against Uzziah the king and said to him, "[It is] not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but for the priests, the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out from the sanctuary, for you have acted unfaithfully, and [it is] not for your honor from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God."
en.B: They confronted King Uzziah and said to him, "It is not your place, Uzziah, to burn incense to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. That belongs to the priests, the sons of Aaron, who have been set apart to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have been unfaithful, and this will bring you no honor from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God."
en.R: They stood in front of King Uzziah to stop him. They said, "Uzziah, you have no right to burn incense to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Only the priests, who come from Aaron's family, may do that. They have been set apart to burn incense. Get out of this holy place! You have been unfaithful to God, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God will not honor you for this."

es.L: Y se opusieron al rey Uzías y le dijeron: «No te [corresponde] a ti, Uzías, quemar incienso {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, sino a los sacerdotes, hijos de Aarón, que están consagrados para quemar incienso. Sal del santuario, porque has obrado con infidelidad, y no [será] para tu honra delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} Dios».
es.B: Se enfrentaron al rey Uzías y le dijeron: «No te corresponde a ti, Uzías, quemar incienso {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Eso les toca a los sacerdotes, los hijos de Aarón, que han sido apartados para quemar incienso. Sal del santuario, porque has sido infiel, y esto no te traerá honra de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} Dios».
es.R: Se pusieron delante del rey Uzías para detenerlo. Le dijeron: «Uzías, tú no tienes derecho a quemar incienso {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Solo los sacerdotes, que son de la familia de Aarón, pueden hacerlo. Ellos han sido apartados para quemar incienso. ¡Sal de este lugar santo! Has sido infiel a Dios, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios no te honrará por esto».

fr.L: Et ils s’opposèrent au roi Ozias et lui dirent : « [Ce n’est] pas à toi, Ozias, de brûler de l’encens {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, mais aux prêtres, les fils d’Aaron, qui sont consacrés pour brûler l’encens. Sors du sanctuaire, car tu as été infidèle, et [cela ne sera] pas pour ton honneur de la part {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} Dieu. »
fr.B: Ils se dressèrent devant le roi Ozias et lui dirent : « Ce n’est pas à toi, Ozias, de brûler de l’encens {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Cela revient aux prêtres, les fils d’Aaron, qui ont été mis à part pour brûler l’encens. Sors du sanctuaire, car tu as été infidèle, et cela ne t’attirera aucun honneur de la part {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} Dieu. »
fr.R: Ils se sont mis devant le roi Ozias pour l’arrêter. Ils lui ont dit : « Ozias, tu n’as pas le droit de brûler de l’encens {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Seuls les prêtres, qui sont de la famille d’Aaron, peuvent le faire. Ils ont été mis à part pour brûler l’encens. Sors de ce lieu saint ! Tu as été infidèle à Dieu, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu ne t’honorera pas pour cela. »

sw.L: Wakasimama dhidi ya Uzia mfalme, wakamwambia, "Si [kazi] yako, Uzia, kumfukizia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uvumba, bali ya makuhani, wana wa Haruni, waliowekwa wakfu kufukiza uvumba. Toka katika patakatifu, kwa maana umekosa uaminifu, wala [haitakuwa] heshima kwako kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu."
sw.B: Walimkabili mfalme Uzia, wakamwambia, "Si kazi yako, Uzia, kumfukizia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uvumba. Kazi hiyo ni ya makuhani, wana wa Haruni, waliowekwa wakfu kufukiza uvumba. Ondoka katika patakatifu, kwa maana umekosa uaminifu, na jambo hili halitakuletea heshima kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu."
sw.R: Walisimama mbele ya mfalme Uzia ili kumzuia. Wakasema, "Uzia, huna haki ya kumfukizia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uvumba. Ni makuhani tu, wanaotoka katika jamaa ya Haruni, wanaoweza kufanya hivyo. Wametengwa kwa ajili ya kufukiza uvumba. Toka mahali hapa patakatifu! Hukuwa mwaminifu kwa Mungu, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu hatakuheshimu kwa jambo hili."

vi.L: Họ đứng chống lại vua Ô-xia và nói với vua: "Hỡi Ô-xia, việc đốt hương cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không [phải] của vua, mà của các thầy tế lễ, con cháu A-rôn, là những người được biệt riêng để đốt hương. Hãy ra khỏi nơi thánh, vì vua đã bất trung, và [việc này] chẳng đem lại vinh dự cho vua từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.B: Họ đứng chặn vua Ô-xia và nói: "Thưa vua Ô-xia, đốt hương cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không phải là phận sự của vua. Việc ấy thuộc về các thầy tế lễ, con cháu A-rôn, là những người đã được biệt riêng để đốt hương. Xin vua ra khỏi nơi thánh, vì vua đã bất trung, và việc này sẽ không đem lại vinh dự gì cho vua trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.R: Họ đứng trước mặt vua Ô-xia để ngăn vua lại. Họ nói: "Thưa vua Ô-xia, vua không có quyền đốt hương cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Chỉ các thầy tế lễ thuộc dòng dõi A-rôn mới được làm việc đó. Họ đã được biệt riêng để đốt hương. Xin vua ra khỏi nơi thánh này! Vua đã bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời sẽ không tôn trọng vua vì việc này."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 웃시야 왕을 막아서서 그에게 말했다. "웃시야여, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 분향하는 것은 임금님의 [일이] 아니고, 분향하도록 거룩하게 구별된 제사장들, 곧 아론의 아들들의 [일입니다]. 성소에서 나가십시오. 임금님께서 신의를 저버리셨으니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님께로부터 임금님께 영광이 [되지] 않을 것입니다."
ko.B: 그들은 웃시야 왕을 막아서서 말했다. "웃시야 임금님, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 분향하는 것은 임금님께서 하실 일이 아닙니다. 그것은 분향하도록 거룩하게 구별된 제사장들, 곧 아론의 자손이 할 일입니다. 성소에서 나가십시오. 임금님께서 신의를 저버리셨으니, 이 일로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님께 영예를 얻지 못하실 것입니다."
ko.R: 그들은 웃시야 왕을 막으려고 그 앞에 섰다. 그들이 말했다. "웃시야 임금님, 임금님께는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 분향할 권한이 없습니다. 아론의 집안에서 나온 제사장들만 그 일을 할 수 있습니다. 그들은 분향하도록 따로 구별된 사람들입니다. 이 거룩한 곳에서 나가십시오! 임금님께서는 하나님께 신실하지 못하셨습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님께서 이 일로 임금님을 높여 주지 않으실 것입니다."

pt.L: E eles se puseram contra o rei Uzias e lhe disseram: "Não [cabe] ao senhor, Uzias, queimar incenso {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, mas aos sacerdotes, os filhos de Arão, que foram consagrados para queimar incenso. Saia do santuário, porque o senhor cometeu infidelidade, e [isso] não [será] para a sua honra da parte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} Deus."
pt.B: Eles enfrentaram o rei Uzias e lhe disseram: "Não cabe ao senhor, Uzias, queimar incenso {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Isso pertence aos sacerdotes, os filhos de Arão, que foram separados para queimar incenso. Saia do santuário, porque o senhor foi infiel, e isso não lhe trará honra da parte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} Deus."
pt.R: Eles se puseram na frente do rei Uzias para impedi-lo. Disseram: "Uzias, o senhor não tem o direito de queimar incenso {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Só os sacerdotes, que são da família de Arão, podem fazer isso. Eles foram separados para queimar incenso. Saia deste lugar santo! O senhor foi infiel a Deus, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} Deus não vai honrá-lo por isso."

decisions.choice: for the priests, the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated: the law of the priesthood
decisions.reason: The law gave the burning of incense to Aaron and his sons (Exodus 30:7-8; Numbers 18:7). After Korah's rebellion, the bronze from the censers was made a sign that no one who was not of Aaron's line should come near to burn incense before Yahweh (Numbers 17:5). Consecrated means set apart for holy service (Exodus 29:1).

decisions.choice: stood against: confronted, opposed
decisions.reason: To stand against someone is to oppose them face to face. The priests stood in the king's way.

decisions.choice: not to you for honor: it will bring you no honor
decisions.reason: The words are short in Hebrew. They mean that what he is doing will not win him honor from God; instead it will bring disgrace, as the next verse shows.

decisions.choice: the sanctuary: the holy place
decisions.reason: The word means the holy place, here the temple building where only priests might go.

decisions.choice: confronted; set apart (Balanced); stood in front of him to stop him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "set apart" for "consecrated". Readable says what standing against him meant, adds "to God" after "unfaithful", and turns the last clause into a plain statement.

decisions.choice: "apartados" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "apartados" for "consecrated", as the English says "set apart"; Literal keeps "consagrados".

decisions.choice: the priests call the king "vua" and add his name, "Hỡi Ô-xia" (L), "Thưa vua Ô-xia" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names him bluntly; Vietnamese keeps the name and the king's title, and "Hỡi" at Literal keeps the force of the rebuke.

decisions.choice: The priests speak to the king in 합쇼체 while they rebuke him, and call him by name
decisions.reason: They oppose the king face to face, but the scene keeps the respect owed to a king, as prophets speak to kings in the Kings drafts; the Hebrew's bare "Uzziah" is kept as "웃시야여" at Literal and "웃시야 임금님" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: o senhor (the priests to the king)
decisions.reason: The priests speak up to their king, so they say "o senhor", the address of a subject to a superior that these books use for the king; the rebuke is in what they say, and the name "Uzias" without the title already shows how bold they are. A prophet speaks to a king with "você" (16:7; 19:2), but these men are subjects in his service.

decisions.choice: consagrados (L), separados (B, R); o santuário (L, B), este lugar santo (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "consagrados", the word Exodus 29 and Leviticus 8 use in Portuguese for setting the priests apart (m1); Balanced and Readable say "separados", as the English says "set apart". The sanctuary (m4) is "o santuário" at Literal and Balanced, the Old Testament term, and "este lugar santo" at Readable.

source.text: וַיִּזְעַף֙ עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וּבְיָד֥וֹ מִקְטֶ֖רֶת לְהַקְטִ֑יר וּבְזַעְפּ֣וֹ עִם־הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְ֠הַצָּרַעַת זָרְחָ֨ה בְמִצְח֜וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל לְמִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And was angry Uzziah, and in his hand [was] a censer to make smoke; and in his being angry with the priests, and the scale disease shone out on his forehead before the priests in [the] house of Yahweh, from beside [the] altar of the incense.

en.L: And Uzziah was angry, and in his hand [was] a censer to burn incense; and when he was angry with the priests, the scale disease broke out on his forehead before the priests in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, beside the altar of incense.
en.B: Uzziah became furious. He had a censer in his hand ready to burn incense, and while he raged at the priests, a serious skin disease broke out on his forehead, there in front of the priests in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, beside the altar of incense.
en.R: Uzziah was holding a censer, ready to burn incense, and he became very angry. While he was raging at the priests, a serious skin disease suddenly appeared on his forehead. It happened right there in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, beside the incense altar, while the priests watched.

es.L: Y Uzías se enojó, y [tenía] en su mano un incensario para quemar incienso; y cuando se enojó con los sacerdotes, la enfermedad de la piel brotó en su frente delante de los sacerdotes en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, junto al altar del incienso.
es.B: Uzías se enfureció. Tenía en la mano un incensario listo para quemar incienso, y mientras se enfurecía contra los sacerdotes, le brotó en la frente una grave enfermedad de la piel, allí delante de los sacerdotes en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, junto al altar del incienso.
es.R: Uzías tenía en la mano un incensario, listo para quemar incienso, y se enojó mucho. Mientras gritaba furioso a los sacerdotes, de repente le apareció en la frente una grave enfermedad de la piel. Sucedió allí mismo, en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, junto al altar del incienso, mientras los sacerdotes miraban.

fr.L: Et Ozias se mit en colère, et dans sa main [il y avait] un encensoir pour brûler de l’encens ; et pendant qu’il était en colère contre les prêtres, la maladie de peau éclata sur son front devant les prêtres, dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, près de l’autel de l’encens.
fr.B: Ozias entra en fureur. Il avait à la main un encensoir pour brûler de l’encens, et pendant qu’il s’emportait contre les prêtres, une maladie de peau grave éclata sur son front, là, devant les prêtres, dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, près de l’autel des parfums.
fr.R: Ozias tenait un encensoir, prêt à brûler de l’encens, et il s’est mis très en colère. Pendant qu’il criait contre les prêtres, une maladie de peau grave est soudain apparue sur son front. C’est arrivé là, dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, près de l’autel des parfums, sous les yeux des prêtres.

sw.L: Uzia akakasirika, na mkononi mwake [kulikuwa na] chetezo cha kufukiza uvumba; naye alipowakasirikia makuhani, ugonjwa wa ngozi ukatokea katika paji la uso wake mbele ya makuhani katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kando ya madhabahu ya uvumba.
sw.B: Uzia alighadhibika. Alikuwa na chetezo mkononi tayari kufukiza uvumba, na alipokuwa akiwakasirikia makuhani, ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi ukatokea katika paji la uso wake, pale pale mbele ya makuhani katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kando ya madhabahu ya uvumba.
sw.R: Uzia alikuwa ameshika chetezo, tayari kufukiza uvumba, naye akakasirika sana. Alipokuwa akiwafokea makuhani, ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi ukatokea ghafla katika paji la uso wake. Ilitokea pale pale katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kando ya madhabahu ya uvumba, makuhani wakiwa wanatazama.

vi.L: Ô-xia nổi giận, trong tay vua [cầm] lư hương để đốt hương; và khi vua nổi giận với các thầy tế lễ, thì bệnh phong hủi nổi lên trên trán vua trước mặt các thầy tế lễ trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, bên cạnh bàn thờ xông hương.
vi.B: Ô-xia nổi giận. Tay vua đang cầm lư hương sẵn sàng đốt hương, và đang khi vua giận dữ với các thầy tế lễ, thì bệnh ngoài da nặng nổi lên trên trán vua, ngay trước mặt các thầy tế lễ trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, bên cạnh bàn thờ xông hương.
vi.R: Ô-xia đang cầm lư hương, sẵn sàng đốt hương, và vua rất giận. Đang khi vua quát tháo các thầy tế lễ, thì một bệnh ngoài da nặng bỗng nổi lên trên trán vua. Việc đó xảy ra ngay trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, bên cạnh bàn thờ xông hương, trước mắt các thầy tế lễ.

ko.L: 그리고 웃시야가 화를 냈다. 그의 손에는 분향하려고 향로가 [있었다]. 그리고 그가 제사장들에게 화를 낼 때에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서, 분향단 곁에서, 제사장들 앞에서 그의 이마에 악성 피부병이 돋아났다.
ko.B: 웃시야는 몹시 화를 냈다. 그는 분향하려고 향로를 손에 들고 있었다. 그가 제사장들에게 화를 내는 동안에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 분향단 곁에서, 제사장들이 보는 앞에서 그의 이마에 심한 피부병이 생겼다.
ko.R: 웃시야는 향을 피우려고 향로를 들고 있다가 몹시 화를 냈다. 그가 제사장들에게 화를 내고 있을 때에, 갑자기 그의 이마에 심한 피부병이 생겼다. 그 일은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 분향단 곁에서, 제사장들이 보는 앞에서 일어났다.

pt.L: E Uzias se irou, e na sua mão [havia] um incensário para queimar incenso; e, quando ele se irou contra os sacerdotes, a doença escamosa irrompeu na sua testa diante dos sacerdotes, na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, junto ao altar do incenso.
pt.B: Uzias ficou furioso. Tinha na mão um incensário, pronto para queimar incenso, e, enquanto se enfurecia contra os sacerdotes, uma doença de pele grave irrompeu na sua testa, ali diante dos sacerdotes, na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, junto ao altar do incenso.
pt.R: Uzias estava segurando um incensário, pronto para queimar incenso, e ficou muito irado. Enquanto gritava com os sacerdotes, uma doença de pele grave apareceu de repente na sua testa. Isso aconteceu ali mesmo, no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, junto ao altar do incenso, enquanto os sacerdotes olhavam.

decisions.choice: scale disease: a skin disease that made a person unclean, not modern leprosy
decisions.reason: The word is the one used in Leviticus 13-14 for a group of skin conditions that made a person unclean and kept him away from the holy things. It is not the same as leprosy as known today. 2 Kings 15:5 says that Yahweh struck the king with it; Chronicles tells how it came about.

decisions.choice: shone out: broke out suddenly and plainly
decisions.reason: The verb is used of the sun rising (Genesis 32:32). The disease appeared all at once, in plain sight of everyone, on the king's forehead.

decisions.choice: a censer: a pan for carrying burning coals and incense
decisions.reason: A censer held live coals on which incense was burned (Ezekiel 8:11; compare the fire pans of Leviticus 16:12). It was the priests' vessel for this service.

decisions.choice: before the priests, beside the altar of incense: judgment in the holy place
decisions.reason: The disease struck at the very altar the king meant to use, before the priests who had warned him. As with Miriam (Numbers 12:10), the mark of the disease came as a sign of God's judgment.

decisions.choice: scale disease (Literal); serious skin disease (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording for the disease follows Leviticus 13 and 2 Kings 15:5. Readable puts the censer first and says "while the priests watched" for "before the priests".

decisions.choice: "la enfermedad de la piel" (L); "una grave enfermedad de la piel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The disease as published Spanish Leviticus and Spanish 2 Kings 15:5 word it at each level; not modern leprosy (m1).

decisions.choice: "maladie de peau" (Literal); "maladie de peau grave" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As French 2 Kings 15:5 for *tsaraʿat*: not "lèpre", which names a modern disease the Hebrew does not mean (m1).

decisions.choice: ugonjwa wa ngozi (L); ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Swahili Leviticus 13 and the 2 Kings drafts, the scale disease is not called "ukoma" (leprosy), which names a different, modern disease (m1).

decisions.choice: "bệnh phong hủi" (L); "bệnh ngoài da nặng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The 2 Kings drafts' words for the same disease (2 Kings 15:5); it is not modern leprosy (m1).

decisions.choice: "악성 피부병" (Literal), "심한 피부병" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording set in the Kings drafts (2 Kings 5; 15:5); "나병" would name modern leprosy, which the disease is not (m1).

decisions.choice: a doença escamosa (L); uma doença de pele grave (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the disease (m1) takes the words of Leviticus 13 and of 2 Kings 15:5 in Portuguese, the verse that tells the same event: "doença escamosa" at Literal and "doença de pele grave" at Balanced and Readable. "Lepra", the word many Portuguese Bibles use here, names Hansen's disease today, which m1 says this is not.

decisions.choice: um incensário; irrompeu (L, B), apareceu de repente (R)
decisions.reason: The censer (m3) is "incensário", the word Leviticus 10:1 and 16:12 use in Portuguese for the priests' fire pans. The verb of the sun rising (m2) is "irrompeu", a sudden breaking out in plain sight; Readable says "apareceu de repente".

source.text: וַיִּ֣פֶן אֵלָ֡יו עֲזַרְיָהוּ֩ כֹהֵ֨ן הָרֹ֜אשׁ וְכָל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְהִנֵּה־ה֤וּא מְצֹרָע֙ בְּמִצְח֔וֹ וַיַּבְהִל֖וּהוּ מִשָּׁ֑ם וְגַם־הוּא֙ נִדְחַ֣ף לָצֵ֔את כִּ֥י נִגְּע֖וֹ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And turned to him Azariah the chief priest and all the priests, and look, he [was] diseased on his forehead; and they hurried him from there, and also he himself hastened to go out, for had struck him Yahweh.

en.L: And Azariah the chief priest and all the priests turned to him, and look, he [had] scale disease on his forehead! And they rushed him out from there, and he himself also hurried to go out, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had struck him.
en.B: When Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, there on his forehead was the skin disease! They rushed him out of there, and he himself hurried to leave, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had struck him.
en.R: Azariah the chief priest and all the other priests looked at him and saw the disease on his forehead. They quickly made him leave the temple. Uzziah himself was in a hurry to get out, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had struck him with the disease.

es.L: Y el sumo sacerdote Azarías y todos los sacerdotes se volvieron hacia él, y he aquí que él [tenía] la enfermedad de la piel en su frente. Y lo sacaron de allí a toda prisa, y él mismo también se apresuró a salir, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había herido.
es.B: Cuando el sumo sacerdote Azarías y todos los sacerdotes lo miraron, vieron en su frente la enfermedad de la piel. Lo sacaron de allí a toda prisa, y él mismo se apresuró a salir, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había herido.
es.R: El sumo sacerdote Azarías y todos los demás sacerdotes lo miraron y vieron la enfermedad en su frente. Enseguida lo hicieron salir del templo. Uzías mismo tenía prisa por salir, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había herido con la enfermedad.

fr.L: Et le grand prêtre Azaria et tous les prêtres se tournèrent vers lui, et voici, il [avait] la maladie de peau sur son front ! Et ils le firent sortir de là en hâte, et lui-même aussi se hâta de sortir, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait frappé.
fr.B: Quand le grand prêtre Azaria et tous les prêtres le regardèrent, la maladie de peau était là, sur son front ! Ils le firent sortir de là en hâte, et lui-même se dépêcha de sortir, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait frappé.
fr.R: Le grand prêtre Azaria et tous les autres prêtres l’ont regardé et ils ont vu la maladie sur son front. Ils l’ont fait sortir du temple tout de suite. Ozias lui-même avait hâte de sortir, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait frappé de cette maladie.

sw.L: Azaria kuhani mkuu na makuhani wote wakamgeukia, na tazama, alikuwa na ugonjwa wa ngozi katika paji la uso wake! Wakamharakisha kutoka huko, naye mwenyewe pia akaharakisha kutoka, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amempiga.
sw.B: Azaria kuhani mkuu na makuhani wote walipomtazama, pale katika paji la uso wake palikuwa na ugonjwa wa ngozi! Wakamtoa huko kwa haraka, naye mwenyewe akaharakisha kuondoka, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amempiga.
sw.R: Azaria kuhani mkuu na makuhani wengine wote walimtazama, wakaona ugonjwa huo katika paji la uso wake. Wakamtoa hekaluni upesi. Uzia mwenyewe alikuwa na haraka ya kutoka, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amempiga kwa ugonjwa huo.

vi.L: Thầy thượng tế A-xa-ria và tất cả các thầy tế lễ quay nhìn vua, và kìa, vua bị phong hủi trên trán! Họ vội đẩy vua ra khỏi đó, và chính vua cũng vội vàng đi ra, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đánh phạt vua.
vi.B: Khi thầy thượng tế A-xa-ria và tất cả các thầy tế lễ nhìn vua, thì kìa, trên trán vua có bệnh ngoài da! Họ vội vàng đưa vua ra khỏi đó, và chính vua cũng vội vã đi ra, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đánh phạt vua.
vi.R: Thầy thượng tế A-xa-ria và tất cả các thầy tế lễ khác nhìn vua và thấy bệnh trên trán vua. Họ vội đưa vua ra khỏi đền thờ. Chính Ô-xia cũng vội vã đi ra, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giáng bệnh ấy trên vua.

ko.L: 그리고 대제사장 아사랴와 모든 제사장이 그를 향해 돌아보니, 보라, 그의 이마에 악성 피부병이 [있었다]! 그리고 그들이 그를 거기서 급히 쫓아냈고, 그 자신도 서둘러 나가려 했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 치셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 대제사장 아사랴와 모든 제사장이 그를 바라보니, 그의 이마에 피부병이 생겨 있었다! 그들은 그를 급히 그곳에서 내보냈고, 그 자신도 서둘러 나가려 했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 치셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 대제사장 아사랴와 다른 모든 제사장이 그를 보니, 그의 이마에 그 병이 생겨 있었다. 그들은 서둘러 그를 성전에서 내보냈다. 웃시야 자신도 빨리 나가고 싶어 했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 그 병이 들게 하셨기 때문이다.

pt.L: E Azarias, o sacerdote-chefe, e todos os sacerdotes se voltaram para ele, e eis que ele [tinha] doença escamosa na sua testa! E o fizeram sair dali às pressas, e ele mesmo também se apressou a sair, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o tinha ferido.
pt.B: Quando Azarias, o sacerdote-chefe, e todos os sacerdotes olharam para ele, ali estava a doença de pele na sua testa! Eles o fizeram sair dali às pressas, e ele mesmo se apressou a sair, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o tinha ferido.
pt.R: Azarias, o sumo sacerdote, e todos os outros sacerdotes olharam para ele e viram a doença na sua testa. Eles o fizeram sair depressa do templo. O próprio Uzias tinha pressa de sair, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o tinha ferido com aquela doença.

decisions.choice: look: what the priests saw
decisions.reason: The word draws the reader into the priests' sight: as they turned, there it was.

decisions.choice: they hurried him out, and he hurried to go: the unclean had to leave the holy place
decisions.reason: A person with this disease was unclean and had to live outside the camp (Leviticus 13:45-46; Numbers 5:2-3). The priests rushed him out, and the king, struck and afraid, now went quickly himself.

decisions.choice: Yahweh had struck him: as 2 Kings 15:5
decisions.reason: Kings uses the same verb: "Yahweh struck the king". Chronicles shows when and why it happened.

decisions.choice: the chief priest: the head of the priests
decisions.reason: "The head priest" is the high priest, the one who led the priesthood (19:11; 24:11).

decisions.choice: the temple; with the disease
decisions.reason: Readable says where "there" was and what the king was struck with. Balanced and Readable say "looked at" for "turned to".

decisions.choice: o sacerdote-chefe (L, B), o sumo sacerdote (R); o tinha ferido
decisions.reason: The head priest (m4) keeps the title 19:11 sets for the book in Portuguese: "o sacerdote-chefe" at Literal and Balanced and "o sumo sacerdote" at Readable, which m4 says he was. "Ferir" is the verb 2 Kings 15:5 uses in Portuguese for the same blow (m3).

source.text: וַיְהִי֩ עֻזִּיָּ֨הוּ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ מְצֹרָ֣ע׀עַד־י֣וֹם מוֹת֗וֹ וַיֵּ֜שֶׁב בֵּ֤ית הַֽחָפְשִׁית֙ מְצֹרָ֔ע כִּ֥י נִגְזַ֖ר מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְיוֹתָ֤ם בְּנוֹ֙ עַל־בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֖ט אֶת־עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And was Uzziah the king diseased until [the] day of his death, and he dwelt [in the] house of the freedom, diseased, for he was cut off from [the] house of Yahweh; and Jotham his son [was] over [the] house of the king, judging [the] people of the land.

en.L: And Uzziah the king was [one] with scale disease until the day of his death, and he lived in the separate house, [one] with scale disease, for he was cut off from the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and Jotham his son [was] over the house of the king, judging the people of the land.
en.B: King Uzziah had a serious skin disease until the day he died. He lived in a separate house because of the disease, for he was shut out of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, while his son Jotham was in charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.
en.R: King Uzziah had the serious skin disease until the day he died. Because of it he lived in a house by himself, and he was not allowed to go into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. His son Jotham was in charge of the palace and ruled the people of the land.

es.L: Y el rey Uzías fue [uno] con enfermedad de la piel hasta el día de su muerte, y habitó en la casa apartada, [con] enfermedad de la piel, porque fue excluido de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y Jotam su hijo [estaba] al frente de la casa del rey, juzgando al pueblo de la tierra.
es.B: El rey Uzías tuvo una grave enfermedad de la piel hasta el día de su muerte. Vivió en una casa apartada a causa de la enfermedad, porque se le había prohibido entrar en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, mientras su hijo Jotam estaba al frente del palacio y gobernaba al pueblo de la tierra.
es.R: El rey Uzías tuvo la grave enfermedad de la piel hasta el día de su muerte. Por eso vivió solo en una casa apartada, y no se le permitía entrar en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Su hijo Jotam estaba al frente del palacio y gobernaba al pueblo del país.

fr.L: Et le roi Ozias fut atteint de maladie de peau jusqu’au jour de sa mort, et il habita dans la maison à part, atteint de maladie de peau, car il était exclu de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et Jotham son fils [était] à la tête de la maison du roi, jugeant le peuple du pays.
fr.B: Le roi Ozias eut une maladie de peau grave jusqu’au jour de sa mort. À cause de cette maladie, il vécut dans une maison à l’écart, car il était exclu de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, tandis que son fils Jotham dirigeait le palais et gouvernait le peuple du pays.
fr.R: Le roi Ozias a eu cette maladie de peau grave jusqu’au jour de sa mort. À cause d’elle, il vivait seul dans une maison à part, et il n’avait pas le droit d’entrer dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Son fils Jotham dirigeait le palais et gouvernait le peuple du pays.

sw.L: Naye Uzia mfalme akawa na ugonjwa wa ngozi mpaka siku ya kufa kwake, akakaa katika nyumba ya kutengwa, akiwa na ugonjwa wa ngozi, kwa maana alikuwa amekatiliwa mbali na nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; na Yothamu mwanawe [alikuwa] juu ya nyumba ya mfalme, akiwahukumu watu wa nchi.
sw.B: Mfalme Uzia alikuwa na ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi mpaka siku alipokufa. Aliishi katika nyumba ya peke yake kwa sababu ya ugonjwa huo, kwa maana alikuwa amezuiliwa kuingia nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye Yothamu mwanawe alikuwa msimamizi wa ikulu na kuwaongoza watu wa nchi.
sw.R: Mfalme Uzia alikuwa na ugonjwa huo mbaya wa ngozi mpaka siku alipokufa. Kwa sababu yake aliishi katika nyumba peke yake, wala hakuruhusiwa kuingia hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mwanawe Yothamu alikuwa msimamizi wa ikulu na kuwatawala watu wa nchi.

vi.L: Vua Ô-xia là [người] bị phong hủi cho đến ngày qua đời, và vua sống trong nhà biệt lập, [là người] bị phong hủi, vì vua bị loại khỏi nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; còn Giô-tham con trai vua [cai quản] cung vua, xét xử dân trong xứ.
vi.B: Vua Ô-xia mắc bệnh ngoài da nặng cho đến ngày qua đời. Vua sống trong một nhà biệt lập vì bệnh ấy, vì vua bị loại khỏi nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, còn Giô-tham con trai vua cai quản cung điện và cai trị dân trong xứ.
vi.R: Vua Ô-xia mang bệnh ngoài da nặng ấy cho đến ngày qua đời. Vì bệnh ấy, vua phải sống riêng trong một ngôi nhà, và không được vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Giô-tham con trai vua cai quản cung điện và cai trị dân trong xứ.

ko.L: 그리고 웃시야 왕이 죽는 날까지 악성 피부병 환자[였고], 악성 피부병 환자로서 따로 떨어진 집에서 살았다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 끊어졌기 때문이다. 그리고 그의 아들 요담이 왕궁을 맡아 그 땅의 백성을 다스렸다.
ko.B: 웃시야 왕은 죽는 날까지 심한 피부병을 앓았다. 그는 그 병 때문에 따로 떨어진 집에서 살았고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어가지 못했다. 그동안 그의 아들 요담이 왕궁을 관리하며 그 땅의 백성을 다스렸다.
ko.R: 웃시야 왕은 죽는 날까지 그 심한 피부병을 앓았다. 그 병 때문에 그는 홀로 떨어진 집에서 살았고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 들어갈 수 없었다. 그의 아들 요담이 왕궁을 맡아 그 땅의 백성을 다스렸다.

pt.L: E o rei Uzias foi [um homem] com doença escamosa até o dia da sua morte, e habitou na casa separada, [um homem] com doença escamosa, porque foi excluído da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; e Jotão, seu filho, [estava] sobre a casa do rei, julgando o povo da terra.
pt.B: O rei Uzias teve uma doença de pele grave até o dia em que morreu. Ele morava numa casa separada por causa da doença, pois tinha sido excluído da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, enquanto o seu filho Jotão estava encarregado do palácio e governava o povo da terra.
pt.R: O rei Uzias teve a doença de pele grave até o dia em que morreu. Por causa dela, ele morava numa casa sozinho e não podia entrar no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. O seu filho Jotão ficou encarregado do palácio e governou o povo da terra.

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 15:5, with a reason added
decisions.reason: The verse follows 2 Kings 15:5. Kings begins "Yahweh struck the king", which Chronicles has already told (verse 20). Chronicles repeats "diseased" and adds "for he was cut off from the house of Yahweh", and it says "Jotham his son" and "the house of the king" where Kings has "Jotham the king's son" and "the house".

decisions.choice: the house of freedom: a separate house, where he lived apart
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 15:5: the word is related to "free", so the phrase is literally "the house of freedom" or "of release". It may mean a house where the king lived released from his duties, or simply a house set apart because of his disease. Its exact sense is not known. The written text and the form marked to be read aloud spell the word slightly differently, with the same sense.

decisions.choice: cut off from the house of Yahweh: shut out of the temple
decisions.reason: Being unclean, he could no longer go to the temple at all (Leviticus 13:46). The king who forced his way into the holy place was barred from the whole house of God for the rest of his life.

decisions.choice: over the house of the king, judging the people of the land: running the palace and governing Judah
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 15:5, Jotham ruled for his father until he became king himself (27:1).

decisions.choice: scale disease (Literal); serious skin disease (Balanced, Readable); separate house / a house by himself
decisions.reason: The wording follows 2 Kings 15:5. Balanced says "because of the disease" for the repeated "diseased", and "shut out" for "cut off"; Readable says he was not allowed to go into the temple.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 15:5, with Chronicles' additions
decisions.reason: The verse follows 2 Kings 15:5 (m1, m2, m4), and so does the Portuguese at each level: "a casa separada" (L), "uma casa separada" (B), "uma casa sozinho" (R), "encarregado do palácio e governava o povo da terra". What Chronicles adds is drafted from its Hebrew: the repeated "com doença escamosa" at Literal, and "excluído da casa do SENHOR" (L, B), said plainly at Readable (m3). Literal says "a casa do rei" where Kings has "a casa", as the Hebrew does.

en.R: Everything else Uzziah did, from beginning to end, was written down by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

ko.R: 웃시야가 한 다른 모든 일은 처음부터 끝까지 아모스의 아들 예언자 이사야가 기록해 두었다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Uzias, os primeiros e os últimos, Isaías, filho de Amoz, o profeta, escreveu.
pt.B: Os demais atos de Uzias, do primeiro ao último, foram escritos pelo profeta Isaías, filho de Amoz.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Uzias fez, do começo ao fim, foi escrito pelo profeta Isaías, filho de Amoz.

decisions.choice: Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet wrote: a source different from 2 Kings 15:6
decisions.reason: Kings points to "the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah" for Azariah's other acts. Chronicles names the prophet Isaiah as the writer, as it names prophets for other kings (9:29; 12:15). Isaiah began his work under Uzziah and saw his vision of the Lord in the year Uzziah died (Isaiah 1:1; 6:1). The book of Isaiah says little about Uzziah's acts, so this was probably a separate writing that has not survived; compare 32:32, "the vision of Isaiah".

decisions.choice: the first and the last: the whole reign
decisions.reason: As in 9:29 and 16:11, the phrase covers all of his acts, from beginning to end.

decisions.choice: were written down by the prophet Isaiah
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with the acts first and "Isaiah wrote" at the end. Balanced and Readable turn it around so the sentence reads easily, using the wording of the sources formula.

decisions.choice: "el profeta Isaías hijo de Amoz"
decisions.reason: The name as the terms note gives it; Spanish keeps the active "los escribió" at every level, which reads naturally with the acts first.

decisions.choice: Isaías, filho de Amoz, o profeta (L); o profeta Isaías, filho de Amoz (B, R); os primeiros e os últimos (L), do primeiro ao último (B), do começo ao fim (R)
decisions.reason: The prophet is named as 2 Kings 19:2 names him in Portuguese: "o profeta Isaías, filho de Amoz" at Balanced and Readable, with Literal keeping the Hebrew order. The rest of the source formula keeps the words 9:29 and 16:11 use in Portuguese (m2); Chronicles names the prophet where 2 Kings 15:6 names the book of the kings (m1), so it is not a question here.

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Uzziah with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in [the] field of the burial which [belonged] to the kings, for they said, Diseased [is] he; and reigned Jotham his son in his place.

en.L: And Uzziah lay down with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial that [belonged] to the kings, for they said, "He [is one] with scale disease." And Jotham his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Then Uzziah rested with his ancestors, and they buried him near his ancestors in the burial field that belonged to the kings, for they said, "He has a serious skin disease." His son Jotham became king in his place.
en.R: Then Uzziah died. He was buried near his ancestors, in a field of graves that belonged to the kings, because people said, "He has a serious skin disease." His son Jotham became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Uzías con sus padres, y lo sepultaron con sus padres en el campo de sepultura que [era] de los reyes, porque dijeron: «Él [tiene] enfermedad de la piel». Y reinó en su lugar Jotam su hijo.
es.B: Luego Uzías descansó con sus antepasados, y lo sepultaron cerca de sus antepasados en el campo de sepultura que pertenecía a los reyes, porque dijeron: «Tiene una grave enfermedad de la piel». Su hijo Jotam reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Luego Uzías murió. Lo sepultaron cerca de sus antepasados, en un campo de sepulturas que pertenecía a los reyes, porque la gente decía: «Tiene una grave enfermedad de la piel». Su hijo Jotam lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Ozias se coucha avec ses pères, et on l’enterra avec ses pères dans le champ de sépulture qui [appartenait] aux rois, car on disait : « Il [est] atteint de maladie de peau. » Et Jotham son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Puis Ozias reposa avec ses ancêtres, et on l’enterra près de ses ancêtres, dans le champ de sépulture des rois, car on disait : « Il a une maladie de peau grave. » Et Jotham son fils régna à sa place.
fr.R: Ensuite Ozias est mort. On l’a enterré près de ses ancêtres, dans un champ de tombes qui appartenait aux rois, parce que les gens disaient : « Il a une maladie de peau grave. » Son fils Jotham est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Uzia akalala pamoja na baba zake, wakamzika pamoja na baba zake katika shamba la maziko lililokuwa la wafalme, kwa maana walisema, "Yeye [ana] ugonjwa wa ngozi." Na Yothamu mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha Uzia akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, wakamzika karibu na babu zake katika shamba la maziko lililokuwa la wafalme, kwa maana walisema, "Ana ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi." Na mwanawe Yothamu akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha Uzia akafa. Akazikwa karibu na babu zake, katika shamba la makaburi lililokuwa la wafalme, kwa sababu watu walisema, "Ana ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi." Na mwanawe Yothamu akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Ô-xia nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và người ta chôn vua với tổ phụ vua trong cánh đồng mộ thuộc về các vua, vì họ nói: "Vua [là người] bị phong hủi." Giô-tham con trai vua trị vì thay vua.
vi.B: Rồi Ô-xia an giấc cùng tổ tiên, và người ta chôn vua gần tổ tiên trong khu đất chôn cất thuộc về các vua, vì họ nói: "Vua mắc bệnh ngoài da nặng." Giô-tham con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Rồi Ô-xia qua đời. Vua được chôn gần tổ tiên, trong một khu đất mộ thuộc về các vua, vì người ta nói: "Vua mắc bệnh ngoài da nặng." Giô-tham con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 웃시야가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 사람들이 그를 왕들에게 [속한] 매장지 밭에 그의 조상들과 함께 묻었다. 그들이 "그는 악성 피부병 환자다" 하고 말했기 때문이다. 그리고 그의 아들 요담이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 웃시야는 조상들과 함께 잠들었다. 사람들은 그를 왕실 묘지에 딸린 밭에 그의 조상들 가까이 묻었다. "그는 심한 피부병을 앓았다" 하고 말했기 때문이다. 그의 아들 요담이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 웃시야는 죽었다. 그는 왕들의 무덤이 있는 곳에 딸린 밭에 그의 조상들 가까이 묻혔다. 사람들이 "그는 심한 피부병을 앓았다" 하고 말했기 때문이다. 그의 아들 요담이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Uzias descansou com os seus pais, e o sepultaram com os seus pais no campo de sepultura que [pertencia] aos reis, porque disseram: "Ele [tem] doença escamosa." E Jotão, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Então Uzias descansou com os seus antepassados, e o sepultaram perto dos seus antepassados, no campo de sepultura que pertencia aos reis, porque diziam: "Ele tem uma doença de pele grave." E o seu filho Jotão reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Então Uzias morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados. Ele foi sepultado perto deles, num campo de túmulos que pertencia aos reis, porque o povo dizia: "Ele tem uma doença de pele grave." O seu filho Jotão se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula of these books, as in 2 Kings 15:7.

decisions.choice: in the field of burial of the kings: where 2 Kings 15:7 says "in the City of David"
decisions.reason: Kings says only that he was buried with his fathers in the City of David. Chronicles adds that he was laid in a field belonging to the royal burial ground, not in the royal tombs themselves, because of his disease. He was near his fathers, but still set apart.

decisions.choice: for they said, He has skin disease: unclean even in death
decisions.reason: His disease made him unclean to the end, and the people would not lay him in the tombs with the other kings. The verse gives their reason in their own words.

decisions.choice: near his ancestors (Balanced, Readable); rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "near" for the second "with his fathers", since he was buried beside the royal tombs, not in them (m2). The death formula keeps its wording at each level; Readable says "was buried" and "people said" for "they buried" and "they said".

decisions.choice: "cerca de sus antepasados"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "cerca de" for the second "with his fathers", since he was buried beside the royal tombs, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the death formula of 2 Kings 15:7; perto dos seus antepassados (B, R)
decisions.reason: The death formula keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 15:7 at each level (m1), with Readable's "foi descansar com os seus antepassados", as 16:13 sets it for the book. Where Kings says "na Cidade de Davi", Chronicles puts him in a field beside the royal tombs (m2), so Balanced and Readable say "perto" for the second "with his fathers", as the English says "near".
